For example, if this spell is cast upon a pressure plate in the floor (that will drop a portcullis when someone steps upon it), there is a 5% chance the mechanism will trigger each time someone walks over it.

sp-01197.description_en: This spell has a 30% chance of opening any nonmagical lock. If the lock is not unlocked, there is a 10% chance that any traps associated with it are set off. Rolls are open-ended and the sophistication of the lock may modify the roll. See Section 7.1.29.

sp-01198.description_en: As Unlock I, except its chances concern disarming traps.

sp-01199.description_en: As Unlock I, except this spell has a 30% chance of operating any non-magical machine in its normal capacity for the duration of the spell. After the duration, the machine will operate normally. For example, if this spell were used to turn a wheel, the wheel would spin for the duration of the spell, then slowly spin to a stop.

sp-01200.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster will be aware when any active magic is in the area of effect. The caster will not know what the magic is or where it is; only that it is in the area of effect. For example, a Dabbler with this spell active can move down a passageway. The moment he gets near magical symbols on a door, he will be warned of active magic in the area (and perhaps the spell casters in the party can set out to find the source).

sp-01201.description_en: As Jam I, except has a 70% chance of jamming the trap (and only a 4% chance of setting it off).

sp-01202.description_en: As Unlock I, except has a 50% chance of opening the lock (and only an 8% chance of setting off associated traps).

sp-01203.description_en: As Untrap I, except has a 50% chance of disarming the trap (and only an 8% chance of setting off the trap).

sp-01204.description_en: As Operate I, except has a 50% chance of operating the machine.

sp-01205.description_en: As Jam I, except has a 90% chance of jamming the trap (and only a 3% chance of setting it off).

sp-01206.description_en: As Unlock I, except has a 70% chance of opening the lock (and only a 6% chance of setting off associated traps).

sp-01207.description_en: As Untrap I, except has a 70% chance of disarming the trap (and a 6% chance of setting off the trap).

sp-01208.description_en: As Operate I, except has a 70% chance of operating the machine.

sp-01209.description_en: As Jam I, except has a 100% chance of jamming the trap (and only a 2% chance of setting it off).

sp-01210.description_en: As Unlock I, except has a 90% chance of opening the lock (and only (and a 4% chance of setting off the trap).

sp-01211.description_en: As Untrap I, except has a 70% chance of disarming the trap (and a 4% chance of setting it off).

sp-01212.description_en: As Operate I, except has a 90% chance of operating the machine.

sp-01213.description_en: As Jam III, except affects all traps in the area of affect.

sp-01214.description_en: As Unlock III, except affects all locks in the area of effect.

sp-01215.description_en: As Untrap III, except affects all traps in the area of effects.

sp-01216.description_en: As Operate III, except affects all machines in the area of effects.

sp-01130.description_en: Allows caster to move at two time normal walking pace (i.e. Run pace). He only expends exhaustion points as if he were walking. Once he stops or performs some other action, the spell is canceled.

sp-01131.description_en: The caster may jump (from any pace) up to 10' plus 5' per level of the caster horizontally, or 5' plus 2' per level of the caster vertically. This spell will allow the caster to always land safely from jumps of this distance or less.

sp-01132.description_en: Allows the caster to land safely in a fall up to 20' per level of the caster; and the caster can take that distance off the severity of any longer fall.

sp-01133.description_en: Allows the caster to cloak all of his movements in complete silence, so long as he moves no faster than a walking pace.

sp-01134.description_en: The caster may move underwater as if he were on land.

sp-01135.description_en: With this spell, the caster gets a +50 bonus to any movement manuevers performed at a walking pace.

sp-01136.description_en: The caster can move (at half walking pace) along any solid surface angled up to 90˚; so long as he keeps at least a 3-point contact with the surface (e.g., both feet and one hand).

sp-01137.description_en: Caster can safely dive through the air up to 50' per level if water deep enough is present (at least 2' of water per 50' dived).

sp-01138.description_en: Caster can move at a walking pace

sp-01139.description_en: As Spider's Step, except caster can move along any surface (including ceilings).

sp-01140.description_en: This spell allows the caster to float upon the air. While floating, the caster is at the mercy of the pervailing winds and cannot control any aspect of his flight without access to some other motive force (i.e., pulling along a rope or wall, being towed, etc.).

sp-01141.description_en: As Spider's Step, except caster may move at a normal walking pace and he needs only to maintain a 2-point contact with the wall.

sp-01142.description_en: As Balance I, except caster may move at two times normal walking pace (i.e., Run pace).

sp-01143.description_en: Caster will safely fall from any distance 99% of the time and will land without making a sound.

sp-01144.description_en: As Spider's Walk, except caster can move at two times normal walking pace (i.e., Run pace).

sp-01145.description_en: Caster can glide like a bird. The product of caster's altitude and horizontal speed cannot exceed 100' per round. For example, a caster can glide along at a rate of 5' per round if he were 20' off the ground; or he could glide at the rate of 50' per round is he were 2' off of the ground. Note that the product must equal 100' (i.e., the caster cannot choose to have a total less than or more than 100').

sp-01146.description_en: As Balance I, except caster can move at three times normal walking pace (i.e., Sprint pace).

sp-01147.description_en: As Spiders Walk, except caster can move along any surface (including ceilings).

sp-01148.description_en: Allows the caster to walk on calm air; movement must be at a constant height (the caster may move vertically, but must do so under his own power—the spell provides no vertical movement capability).

sp-01149.description_en: As Balance I, except caster can move at any pace.

sp-01150.description_en: Caster may use any lower level spell from this list once per round.

sp-01173.description_en: Caster gains double normal hearing. This results in +50 to Perception involving only hearing, +25 to Perception involving hearing and other senses.

sp-01174.description_en: Caster can see 100' on a normal night as if it were daylight. See Section 7.1.19.

sp-01175.description_en: Caster gains an extremely acute sense of smell. This results in +50 to Perception involving only smell, +25 to Perception involving smell and other senses.

sp-01176.description_en: One location is “marked” so that the caster can find it again later with a Far Sense spell. The marker is automatically located when the caster casts a Far Sense spell if the marker is within range of the Far Sense spell. A marker can be placed on any inanimate object. The caster can only have as many markers as he has levels.

sp-01177.description_en: Caster may designate one of his senses to be used at any “marked” location within range (see Sensory Marker). The caster can use any perception skill he has at the time (e.g., if he is currently under the effects of Nightvision, he will have Nightvision at the marked location). The remote sensory point may be rotated to face any direction. While he is sensing at the marked location, he must remain immobile and concentrate.

sp-01178.description_en: Caster has a 300˚ field of vision. The flank bonus for attacks against the caster is lowered to +5 and the rear bonus is lowered to +15.

sp-01179.description_en: Caster gains extreme tactile sensitivity. This results in a +25 to all actions that depend on the tactile sense (e.g., pick locks, disarm traps, etc.).

sp-01180.description_en: Caster can see 100' in any water (including murky water) as if it were daylight.

sp-01181.description_en: As Nightvision, except any darkness can be seen through. Also, no light is needed for this spell to work.

sp-01182.description_en: As Far Sense I, except caster may designate up to two senses at the marked location.

sp-01183.description_en: Caster can see through wood (up to 1"/lvl).

sp-01184.description_en: Caster can see in any brightness of light (including that which would be blinding or glaring). This spell does not work in the absence of light.

sp-01185.description_en: As Far Sense I, except caster can move (though he must continue to concentrate).

sp-01186.description_en: As Far Sense I, except for range.

sp-01187.description_en: As Woodsight, except that caster can see through stone.

sp-01188.description_en: As Far Sense II, except caster can move (though he must continue to concentrate).

sp-01189.description_en: As Woodsight, except that caster can see through iron (or steel).

sp-01190.description_en: As Far Sense II, except for range.

sp-01191.description_en: As all Vision spells on this list operating at the same time.

sp-01192.description_en: Caster has the effects of Sly Ears, Scent, Touch, and all Vision spells simultaneously.

sp-01193.description_en: Caster may use any lower level spell on this list once per round.

sp-01217.description_en: The caster gets a feeling for how much the target of this spell believes he is worth (i.e., his net worth). Note that this could be drastically different than how much money the target has (as wealth could include land, livestock, etc.).

sp-01218.description_en: The caster knows approximately how much “wealth” the target has upon his person.

sp-01219.description_en: The caster magically “marks” a target for use with the Locate Target spell. The caster can only have one target marked at a time.

sp-01220.description_en: Locates the nearest person (within the area of effect; direction and distance) who wants a specific object. The caster must be touching the object at the time this spell is cast.

sp-01221.description_en: The caster knows the exact location (direction and distance) of a “marked” target.

sp-01222.description_en: Caster can assess the value of jewels and metals within 10% of actual value. This spell allows him to calculate different values for all the cultures he is familiar with. Note that this spell evaluates the materials only (not the craftsmanship or the magical properties).

sp-01223.description_en: As Jewel/ Metal Assessment, except this spell will take into account the craftsmanship of the item. Magical properties are not evaluated.

sp-01224.description_en: Locates the nearest person (within the area of effect; direction and distance) who wants a specific object and is willing to acquire it at this time. The caster must be touching the object at the time this spell is cast.

sp-01225.description_en: Detects magical power in an item (but not the realm or how much power is in the item).

sp-01226.description_en: Caster has a 10% chance of determining the enchanted abilities of an object (roll separately for each ability). Once this spell has been cast on an item, it may not be cast on the same item again until the caster has gained a level of experience. See Section 7.1.4.

sp-01227.description_en: The caster knows the location of the owner of a specified object (the caster must be touching the object at the time that this spell is cast). The owner must be within the area of effect. For the purposes of this spell, the owner of an object is defined as someone who has “legal” ownership of the object. The GM must determine what constitutes legal ownership in his world (e.g., the creator, the purchaser of the created item, possessor, etc.).

sp-01228.description_en: Locates the nearest person (within the area of effect; direction and distance) who wants a specific object, is willing to acquire it at this time, and is willing to acquire it in a non-violent fashion. The caster must be touching the object at the time this spell is cast.

sp-01229.description_en: As Item Assessment, except that any item can be assessed (e.g., livestock, houses, boats, etc.).

sp-01230.description_en: Determines if the item examined has any cultural or historical significance (but not exactly what the significance is).

sp-01231.description_en: As Find Owner I, except for area of effect.

sp-01232.description_en: Locates the nearest person (within the area of effect; direction and distance) who wants a specific object, is willing to acquire it at this time (in a non-violent fashion), and is willing to pay the best price. The caster must be touching the object at the time this spell is cast.

sp-01233.description_en: Gives the area of origin of the item, the race of the being who created it, and when it was made (within 100 years).

sp-01234.description_en: As Find Owner I, except for area of effect.

sp-01235.description_en: Caster gets a visual image of the owner of an item.

sp-01236.description_en: Gives a vision of a significant event in the item's past.

sp-01237.description_en: As Origins, except it gives the exact place of origin, the being who made it, and when it was made.

sp-01238.description_en: As Find Owner I, except for area of effect.

sp-01239.description_en: Adds +50 to any rolls for any maneuvers performed at a walking pace (e.g., walking a 3" beam).

sp-01240.description_en: Allows the caster to slightly alter his muscles, limbs, and torso. This facilitates escaping from bonds and small places. Gives a +25 to +50 bonus to maneuvers utilizing Contortion skill.

sp-01241.description_en: Adds +20 to any one maneuver. No other action can be performed the round this maneuver is resolved.

sp-01242.description_en: Caster is able to sustain an additional 25% of his total concussion hits before passing out, hits are still taken and remain when the spell lapses.

sp-01243.description_en: Allows caster to alter form of his face to resemble someone else.

sp-01244.description_en: Caster can breathe water but not air for the duration of this spell.

sp-01245.description_en: As Concentration I, except bonus is 30.

sp-01246.description_en: In melee, the caster does double normal concussion hits and his Strength stat bonus is doubled.

sp-01247.description_en: As Unpain I, except 50% additional hits may be sustained.

sp-01248.description_en: As Face Shifting, except the form of the body can be altered slightly to the general shape and size of the desired humanoid race (must be within 25% of the caster's normal mass).

sp-01249.description_en: As Concentration I, except bonus is 40.

sp-01250.description_en: As Strength II, except caster delivers triple concussion damage and his Strength stat bonus is tripled.

sp-01251.description_en: Awakens the caster from any unnatural sleep (e.g., Sleep spell, sleeping drug, etc.). Caster takes one round to awaken.

sp-01252.description_en: Caster can breathe any gas as if it were normal air.

sp-01253.description_en: As Unpain I, except 75% additional hits may be sustained.

sp-01254.description_en: As Concentration I, except bonus is 50.

sp-01255.description_en: This spell halves the normal amount of time needed for rest. For example, after a normal day, instead of needed only 8 hours of sleep, the caster will need only 4. This spell will remain in effect for the duration of the sleep.

sp-01256.description_en: As Unpain I, except 100% additional hits may be sustained.

sp-01257.description_en: During a normal sleep, the caster may make Perception rolls (that are not based upon sight), at no penalty.

sp-01258.description_en: Upon receiving a death blow, the caster goes into a state of suspended animation, until he is cured or his brain is destroyed.

sp-01259.description_en: As Monk's Sleep and Meditative Sleep operating at the same time.

sp-01260.description_en: As Strength II, except caster delivers four times normal concussion damage and his strength stat bonus is quadrupled.

sp-01261.description_en: As Unpain I, except caster ignores all pain. Thus, he ignores all penalties (i.e., negative modifiers to actions) due to wounds and his hit total is double his normal hits plus his constitution (on a 1-100 scale). When he exceeds this limit he does not pass out, he dies from system shock.

sp-06610.description_en: Allows caster to leap up to 10' vertically or laterally, grasp and swing from a fixed object, and land perfectly (up to 20' away from the object). The object could be a tree, branch, rafter, rope, chandelier, etc.

sp-06611.description_en: Caster may act at twice his normal rate (i.e., 200% activity per round), but immediately afterwards, he must spend a number of rounds equal to the rounds speeded at half rate (i.e., only 50% activity per round).

sp-06612.description_en: Allows caster to “dodge” one nonspell attack (missile or melee) that occurs during the same round that this spell is cast. The caster must be able to see the attack (i.e., they cannot be from the rear or invisible) and he must have room to dodge the attack; this results in the attack receiving a -50 modification.

sp-06613.description_en: As Swing I, except three Swing I's may be executed in rapid succession.

sp-06614.description_en: Allows caster to “flip” in any direction, landing up to 10' away (facing in any direction).

sp-06615.description_en: As Speed I, except no half rate rounds are required.

sp-06616.description_en: As Speed I, except duration is 3 rounds.

sp-06617.description_en: As Dodging I, except 3 attacks can be dodged.

sp-06618.description_en: As Swing I, except five Swing I's may be executed in rapid succession.

sp-06619.description_en: As Speed I, except duration is 5 rounds.

sp-06620.description_en: As Flip I, except three Flip I's may be executed in rapid succession.

sp-06621.description_en: As Haste I, except duration is 3 rounds.

sp-06622.description_en: As Dodging I, except 4 attacks can be dodged.

sp-06623.description_en: As Speed I, except duration is 7 rounds.

sp-06624.description_en: As Haste I, except duration is 4 rounds.

sp-06625.description_en: As Flip I, except total distance travelled is 1' per level.

sp-06626.description_en: As Dodging I, except 5 attacks can be dodged.

sp-06627.description_en: As Speed I, except duration is 10 rounds.

sp-06628.description_en: As Haste I, except duration is 5 rounds.

sp-06629.description_en: As Dodging I, except all attacks can be dodged.

sp-06630.description_en: As Haste I, except duration is 10 rounds.

sp-06631.description_en: Caster can use any one of the lower level non- Speed/Haste spells (on this list) each round.

sp-01307.description_en: Caster gets a +5 bonus to all Martial Arts attacks.

sp-01308.description_en: Caster gets a +20 bonus for all Adrenal Moves.

sp-01309.description_en: Caster gets a +20 for attempts to deflect, block, or parry one missile attack.

sp-01310.description_en: Caster can strike an inanimate object and deliver damage to it (taking no damage himself). Caster makes a normal Martial Arts Strikes attack against the object. In addition, there is a chance that the object that is struck will break if it has any flaws (e.g., cracks, fractures, etc.) in it. The chance is equal to 10% plus 1% per degree of severity of the critical delivered in the attack (i.e., 'A' critical = 5%, 'B' critical = 10%, etc.). This chance is modified by +10% to +50% depending on the severity of the flaws.

sp-01311.description_en: As Adrenal Focus II, except bonus is +30.

sp-01312.description_en: As Body Weaponry I, except bonus is +10.

sp-01313.description_en: As Missile's Master II, except bonus is +30.

sp-01314.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster's skin is treated as AT 3 (this is only effective if the caster is wearing no armor at all).

sp-01315.description_en: The caster may ignore the effects of the first critical strike made against him. At the end of this spell's duration, all effects apply normally. Only one wound can be ignored in this fashion at a time (i.e., the caster cannot have more than one Lion's Heart spell active at any given time).

sp-01316.description_en: As Adrenal Focus II, except bonus is +40.

sp-01317.description_en: As Shattering Blow I, except the chance of breaking the object is 25% plus 3% per degree of severity of the critical.

sp-01318.description_en: As Body Weaponry I, except bonus is +15.

sp-01319.description_en: As Missile's Master II, except bonus is +40.

sp-01320.description_en: As Adrenal Focus II, except bonus is +50.

sp-01321.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster's skin is treated as AT 4 (this is only effective if the caster is wearing no armor at all).

sp-01322.description_en: As Shattering Blow I, except the chance of breaking the object is 40% plus 6% per degree of severity of the critical.

sp-01323.description_en: As Missile's Master II, except bonus is +50.

sp-01324.description_en: As Body Weaponry I, except bonus is +20.

sp-01325.description_en: As Adrenal Focus II, except bonus is +75.

sp-01326.description_en: As Body Weaponry I, except bonus is +30.

sp-01327.description_en: As Shattering Blow I, except the chance of breaking the object is 50% plus 10% per degree of severity of the critical.

sp-01328.description_en: Caster may use any one of the lower level spells on this list, once per round.

sp-01329.description_en: Allows caster to leap 50' laterally or 20' vertically in the round that the spell is cast.

sp-01330.description_en: Allows the caster to land safely in a fall of up to 20' per level, and to take that distance off the severity of any longer fall.

sp-01331.description_en: Caster can run on even, unstable surfaces (sand, ice, etc.) as he would on a hard, stable surface.

sp-01397.description_en: Caster can run on even, narrow (at least 2" wide) surfaces as if he were on normal ground.

sp-01333.description_en: As Leaping I, except the caster can execute 3 “leaps” in succession. Each leap must be within 90˚ of the last leap's direction.

sp-01334.description_en: Allows caster to execute a turn up to 180˚ with no deceleration or unbalance (this spell can be used with any Running spells).

sp-01335.description_en: Allows caster to move up and down vertically at a rate of 10' per rond. Horizontal movement is possible only through normal means.

sp-01336.description_en: As Landing, except caster can land safely from any fall 99% of the time.

sp-01398.description_en: Caster can walk on solid surfaces up to 90˚ as if he were on normal ground.

sp-01338.description_en: As Leaping I, except limit is 10' per level laterally and 5' per level vertically.

sp-01339.description_en: As Cornering I, except caster may execute 3 such turns in one round.

sp-01340.description_en: If the caster has a wall within 10', he can leap up to the wall, bounce off and land up to 25' from the wall (facing any direction—no orientation roll required).

sp-01399.description_en: As Wallwalking, except caster may run.

sp-01342.description_en: Caster teleports to a point up to 100' away. There can be no intervening “barriers” in a direct line between the caster and the point. A “barrier” is defined as anything the caster could not physically go through (e.g., a closed door is a barrier, a pit is not).

sp-01400.description_en: Caster can run on air if there is a wind blowing. However, he cannot run into the wind; and when running in any other direction, the wind's speed will modify his movement rate (i.e., like the effect of wind on a sail boat).

sp-01401.description_en: Caster may run on any fluid surface as if on level ground.

sp-01345.description_en: As Leaving I, except range is 300'.

sp-01402.description_en: As Breezerunning, except may run against the wind, and his movement rate is unaffected by the wind speed.

sp-01403.description_en: Caster can walk on any solid surfaces as if he were on normal ground (includes ceilings).

sp-01404.description_en: As Ceilingwalking, except caster may run.

sp-01349.description_en: Caster can use any one of the lower level “running” spells (on this list) each round.

sp-01350.description_en: Caster can use any one of the lower level spells (on this list) each round.

sp-01351.description_en: Caster gains double normal hearing. This results in +50 to Perception involving only hearing, +25 to Perception involving hearing and other senses.

sp-01352.description_en: Caster can see 100' on a normal night as if it were daylight. See Section 7.1.19.

sp-01353.description_en: Caster has a 300˚ field of vision. The flank bonus for attacks against the caster is lowered to +5 and the rear bonus are lowered to +15.

sp-01354.description_en: Caster gains an extremely acute sense of smell. This results in +50 to Perception involving only smell, +25 to Perception involving smell and other senses.

sp-01355.description_en: Caster can see 100' in any water (including murky water) as if it were daylight.

sp-01356.description_en: Caster can see 100' in any precipitation (including thick fog) as if it were daylight.

sp-01357.description_en: Caster gains extreme tactile sensitivity. This results in a +25 to all actions that depend on the tactile sense (e.g., pick locks, disarm traps, etc.).

sp-01358.description_en: As Nightvision, except any darkness can be seen through. Also, no light is needed for this spell to work.

sp-01359.description_en: Detects any invisible object in the area of effect. Caster can concentrate on a different 5'R each round.

sp-01360.description_en: Caster can check one object or place (up to 5'R) and tell if is an illusion or has an illusion on it.

sp-01361.description_en: As Scent, except caster can detect extremely faint scents (e.g., up to 48 hours old, after rain storms, through snow, etc.).

sp-01362.description_en: One illusion within the area of effect ceases to exist for the caster only.

sp-01364.description_en: Caster can see through wood (up to 1" per level).

sp-01365.description_en: Caster can see all invisible things anywhere that he can normally see. In addition, he suffers no penalties against invisible targets (as they are not invisible to him).

sp-01366.description_en: As any of the lower level Vision spells on this list but without a range limit (i.e., they will allow the caster to see anywhere he could normally see).

sp-01367.description_en: Caster cannot see any visual illusions. This does not affect any of the other senses.

sp-01368.description_en: As Woodsight, except stone can be seen through.

sp-01369.description_en: As all lower level Vision spells functioning at the same time.

sp-01370.description_en: As Woodsight, except iron (or steel) can be seen through.

sp-01371.description_en: As Woodsight, except any metal can be seen through.

sp-01372.description_en: Caster can use any one of the lower level spells (on this list) each round.

sp-00722.description_en: A random part of a random limb is sprained. If it is part of a leg: movement is cut by 25%, melee and missile attacks are modified by -10. If it is part of an arm, melee and missile attacks are modified by -20.

sp-00723.description_en: A random limb is in intense pain. For a leg, the target cannot walk (target may crawl at 10% of his normal movement); for an arm, that arm cannot be used.

sp-00724.description_en: The bones and tissues of the target's body are disrupted as if the target had fallen a long distance. If the target fails his RR by 1-10, he takes an 'A' Impact critical; by 11-20, he takes a 'B'; by 21-30, he takes a'C'; by 31-40, he takes a'D'; by more than 41, he takes an 'E'.

sp-00725.description_en: One of the target's joints locks. Target suffers the effects of Limb Pain. A moving target with a locked leg falls. A target with a locked arm drops anything he is carrying.

sp-00726.description_en: A random limb is broken. A broken arm is useless. One broken leg cuts movement by 50% and combat is modified by -75.

sp-00727.description_en: As Touch of Disruption, except range is 20'.

sp-00728.description_en: Target's skin will flake and peel all over his body. There is no tactical penalty, but target's Appearance is lowered by -50 (to a minimum of 1). Lasts until dispelled and 1 month passes. Magical healing could reduce this time.

sp-00729.description_en: As Touch of Disruption, except range is 50'.

sp-00730.description_en: One of the target's ears (random) is disrupted. His hearing is at 50% of normal until cured. This results in a -25 penalty to Perception involving hearing; -50 to Perception only involving hearing. If this spell is cast upon the same ear twice, the target is deaf in that ear.

sp-00731.description_en: One of the target's limbs (random) will wither and die. Target loses 5% of the use of the limb per day; when the total reaches 100%, the limb falls off. Can be cured through circulation and nerve repair spells up to the 80% point, then it must be regenerated. If the limb is a leg, movement is reduced by half the percentage lost (e.g., if a leg is 60% withered, movement is cut by 30%). If the limb is an arm, combat suffers a -1 penalty per 1% withered (e.g., if an arm is 75% withered, all combat will suffer a -75 penalty).

sp-00732.description_en: As Ear Disruption, except an eye is affected (as well as visual perception).

sp-00733.description_en: One of the target's lungs collapses. He is at 50% of normal for all activity until the lung is repaired.

sp-00734.description_en: As Limb Death, except a random muscle is affected (not muscle organs, e.g., not the heart).

sp-00735.description_en: As Limb Death, except a random bone (not part of spine or skull) gradually disintegrates.

sp-00736.description_en: One of the Black Channel I spells may be used (see Section 7.1.23).

sp-00737.description_en: As any single 10th level or lower spell on this list, except with a range of 300'.

sp-00738.description_en: As any single lower level spell, except it may be cast upon as many targets as the caster has levels.

sp-00739.description_en: The target's bones will gradually petrify; a loss of activity (as in Limb Death) occurs due to loss of blood production.

sp-00740.description_en: As Black Channel I, except one of the Black Channel II spells may be used.

sp-00741.description_en: As Touch of Disruption, except range is 300' and always delivers an 'E' Impact critical if the target fails to resist.

sp-00742.description_en: As Black Channel I, except one of the Black Channel III spells may be used.

sp-00743.description_en: For each level of the caster, he may vaporize 10 cubic feet of liquid.

sp-00744.description_en: For each level of the caster, he may freeze 10 cubic feet of liquid. Caster is immune to the cold.

sp-00745.description_en: Causes 1,000 cubic feet of liquid to rapidly evaporate (over the course of 1 hour).

sp-00746.description_en: Instantly disintegrates 100 cubic feet of water.

sp-00747.description_en: Water within the area of effect is calmed. Waves are cut 20' in center and less towards the perimeter.

sp-00748.description_en: A bolt of water is shot from the palm of the caster. Attack is resolved on the Water Bolt Attack Table.

sp-00749.description_en: No precipitation will occur in the area of effect for the duration of this spell.

sp-00750.description_en: Removes all the liquid (usually water) from 1 cubic foot of inanimate material.

sp-00751.description_en: As Evaporate I, except 10,000 cubic feet are affected.

sp-00752.description_en: As Unwater I, except 1000 cubic feet are affected.

sp-00753.description_en: As Unrain, except area of effect and duration.

sp-00754.description_en: As Dehydrate, except affects 10 cubic feet.

sp-00755.description_en: As Evaporate I, except affects 100,000 cubic feet.

sp-00756.description_en: As Unwater I, except affects 10,000 cubic feet.

sp-00757.description_en: As Calm Water, except waves are cut by 50' in center.

sp-00758.description_en: As any single 10th level or lower spell on this list, except with a range of 300'.

sp-00759.description_en: The target immediately begins to dehydrate and weather as if in a wind-blown, sandy desert. The target is immediately at -10% to activity and takes 1% of his total hits. For each round that the caster concentrates, the target loses another 5% activity and 1% of his total hits. If the caster maintains concentration for 28 consecutive rounds, animate targets will be reduced to dried out husks (i.e., when the activity penalty reaches 150%). If the caster is prevented from completing his rounds of concentration or the target gets out of the range of the spell, the target keeps the accumulated activity penalty and hits lost. The hits may be healed normally, but the activity penalty only recovers at the rate of 10% per day. Alternatively, the GM may allow the activity penalty to be removed with a Cure Disease spell (or its equivalent) cast after all of the hits are restored.

sp-00760.description_en: For every minute that the caster concentrates, the humidity drops 1% of the original humidity (up to 50%). The humidity will gradually increase at a rate of 5% (of original humidity) per day until the original humidity is reached. Note that this change in humidity levels could affect an area's climate (in turn affecting the area's vegetation).

sp-00761.description_en: As Evaporate I, except 1,000,000 cubic feet can be affected.

sp-00762.description_en: As Calm Water, except area of effect is 1,000'R per level of the caster.

sp-00763.description_en: Every minute that the caster concentrates, the humidity drops 5% of the original humidity (up to 95%). The humidity increases as in Dehumidify. Note that this change in humidity levels could affect an area's climate (in turn affecting the area's vegetation).

sp-00764.description_en: Disperses all fog in a 10'/lvl R.

sp-00765.description_en: Cuts all generalized air movement (e.g., wind) by 30 mph in a 10'R (will not affect breathing).

sp-00766.description_en: Creates a 5'R near vacuum; anyone within the radius must make a successful RR or take a 'B' Impact critical as the air leaves and rushes back in.

sp-00767.description_en: Caster can remove the oxygen in a 10'R at the rate of 1% of the original oxygen each round.

sp-00768.description_en: As Air Stop I, except affects a radius of 20'.

sp-00769.description_en: As Vacuum I, except affects a radius of 10'.

sp-00770.description_en: As Deoxygenation I, except affects a radius of 20'.

sp-00771.description_en: Changes any gas to normal air at a rate of 1cubic per round as long as the caster concentrates.

sp-00772.description_en: As Air Stop I, except affects a radius of 100'.

sp-00773.description_en: As Vacuum I, except delivers a 'D' Impact critical.

sp-00774.description_en: As Deoxygenation I, except removal rate is 5% per round.

sp-00775.description_en: As Deoxygenation I, except affects a radius of 50'.

sp-00776.description_en: As Great Vacuum I, except affects a radius of 10'.

sp-00777.description_en: As Mass Deoxygenation I, except affects a radius of 20'.

sp-00778.description_en: As any single 10th level or lower spell on this list, except with a range of 300'.

sp-00779.description_en: As Deoxygenation I, except affects a radius of 20' and removeal rate is 10% per round.

sp-00780.description_en: As Vacuum I, except delivers an 'E' Impact critical.

sp-00781.description_en: As Deoxygenation I, except affects a radius of 20' and removal rate is 20% per round.

sp-00782.description_en: As Major Vacuum, except affects a 10'R.

sp-00783.description_en: Destroys gases in a single enclosure (e.g., usually a building) up to a size of 100'x100'x100' (or 1,000,000 cu'). The building has a chance of collapsing (dependent on construction) and everyone inside takes an 'E' Impact critical from falling debris. This results in a very loud explosion. If the building collapses, everyone within 100' of the building takes a 'C' Impact critical from the explosion.

sp-00784.description_en: Target takes 25% of his remaining concussion hits (i.e., those not already taken). These hits are restored when the duration is up, provided target has not died.

sp-00786.description_en: Target must subtract 25 from all orientation and perception rolls, and 5 from all initiative rolls.

sp-00787.description_en: Target must subtract 25 from all maneuver rolls.

sp-00788.description_en: Target must subtract 25 from all attack rolls.

sp-00789.description_en: As Jolts I, except for duration.

sp-00790.description_en: As Minor Pain, except 50% of remaining hits are taken.

sp-00791.description_en: Target forgets a period of (1 minute per level) of his past, as desired by the caster.

sp-00792.description_en: As Major Pain, except hits must be healed normally.

sp-00793.description_en: As Disorientation, Unbalance, and Distortions (all at once).

sp-00794.description_en: Target mind blanks out for a period of 10 minutes each day at random. Target is incapable of activity or thought during this period.

sp-00795.description_en: As Jolts I, except for duration.

sp-00796.description_en: Target's mind is completely blank for the duration. He cannot perceive events, time, or activity. At the end of the duration of this spell, he is stunned for 1 round after his mind comes back.

sp-00797.description_en: As Disorientation, except affects a number of targets equal to the caster's level.

sp-00798.description_en: Target is a blathering idiot. He can be lead around, but he can take no action.

sp-00799.description_en: As Unbalance, except affects a number of targets equal to the caster's level.

sp-00800.description_en: As any single 10th level or lower spell on this list, except with a range of 300'.

sp-00801.description_en: As Distortions, except affects a number of targets equal to the caster's level.

sp-00802.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] The target believes he is being engaged by a creature of the his own worst fears. The target will be attacked each round by the creature (who has a +100 Martial Arts Strikes Rank I attack; the damage is real). Regardless of the damage done by the target (to the creature), the creature will only be defeated when the target makes his RR (one RR each minute), or when he loses consciousness.

sp-00803.description_en: Target loses 5% of his collected experience (usually experience points). Note that the target will not lose a level, only experience points (which means he will have to gain that many more experience points to gain his next level).

sp-00804.description_en: As Major Pain, except as many targets as the caster's level are affected, the duration is until healed, and the range is 300'.

sp-00805.description_en: As Mind Shock, except as many targets as the caster's level can be affected and the range is 300'.

sp-00806.description_en: As Unminding, except as many targets as the caster's level can be affected and the range is 300'.

sp-00807.description_en: For each level of the caster, he may melt up to 10 cubic feet of ice.

sp-00808.description_en: Loosens 100 cubic feet of earth to the consistency of plowed ground.

sp-00809.description_en: For each level of the caster, he causes a 100 cubic foot section of inorganic material to erode and deteriorate at 1,000 x normal rate.

sp-00810.description_en: Any previous cracks or flaws in material up to 10'x10'x10' (not 1,000 cubic feet) section will extend to their limit. See Section 7.1.13.

sp-00811.description_en: Will vaporize a non-magic door up to 6" thick, 10' high, and 10' wide (if the door is thicker than 6" it will vaporize the closest 6 inches). This will only work on an object that is used as a door (e.g., a caster cannot Undoor a section of wall).

sp-00812.description_en: Changes 100 cubic feet of stone to packed earth. Change is gradual (taking 3 rounds for full effect).

sp-00813.description_en: As Stone/Earth, except changes earth to soft mud.

sp-00814.description_en: Creates a 3'x6' corridor that is 1' per level long. It can cut through any non-metal, inorganic material. The corridor is created at a rate of 1' (length) per round as long as the caster concentrates.

sp-00815.description_en: Can shatter an inorganic object, up to 1 cubic foot. All within a 5'R take an 'A' Impact critical and holder takes a 'C'. Metal objects get a +30 RR modification.

sp-00818.description_en: As Undoor, except any single door is vaporized.

sp-00819.description_en: As Unearth, except affects 1 cubic foot of metal.

sp-00820.description_en: As any single 10th level or lower spell on this list, except with a range of 300'.

sp-00821.description_en: Causes a large crack to open in the ground. The size of the crack will be up to 10' wide, up to 100' deep, and up to 200' long. The crack takes 2 rounds to open.

sp-00822.description_en: As Unearth, except it will disintegrate 1 cubic foot per level of the caster of any inanimate solid.

sp-00823.description_en: Causes a very minor earthquake which could cause shoddy construction to collapse (can be very terrifying). This is approximately 5.5 on the Richter scale.

sp-00824.description_en: Causes a large crevice to open in the ground (up to 10' per level deep, 1' per level wide and 20' per level long). The crevice takes 2 rounds to open. The caster can concentrate for 3 rounds to close the crevice.

sp-00825.description_en: Caster can cause an earthquake, with the spot he touches as the epicenter. The quake can be delayed up to 1 rnd/ lvl. The severity of the quake on the Richter scale is determined by a d100 roll: (01-20) = 5.5, (21-45) = 6, (46-65) = 6.5, (66-80) = 7.0, (81-90) = 7.5, (91-95) = 8.0, (96-98) = 8.5, (99-100) = 9.0.

sp-00826.description_en: Target must answer a single concept question (presuming that the target can understand the question).

sp-00827.description_en: Target is possessed by a minor Demon. Caster has no control over the target or the Demon. The Demon will force the target to do random (not necessarily destructive) things. Target gets an RR every other round to attempt to get rid of the Demon.

sp-00828.description_en: Target has an extreme dislike for any specific thing the caster chooses. Target has a 50% chance of overcoming the neurosis when given a choice. For example, a neurosis concerning horses would mean that every time the target tried to get on or near a horse he would only have a 50% chance. This chance is modified by three times his Self Discipline stat bonus.

sp-00829.description_en: Target becomes guilty over some action in his past. The GM should choose some significant event in the target's past. He will not perform similar actions again and must take steps to alleviate the guilt.

sp-00830.description_en: Target will trust no one absolutely. When in a life threatening/dangerous situation, there is a 50% chance (modified by Self Discipline bonus x 3) that he will not put his safety in the hands of others.

sp-00831.description_en: As Demonic Possession I, except target gets an RR only once every minute.

sp-00832.description_en: Target will flee in panic in any personally dangerous situation, unless he successfully makes an RR. Target is required to make an RR only once per combat. Fleeing equates to movement away for d10 rounds at maximum pace.

sp-00833.description_en: Target's “soul” and the caster's “soul” are interchanged; the caster can operate at 50% of his normal activity in the body of the target. The target in the caster's body is inactive. The caster can cancel the spell at any time (takes 1 rnd), the target can only cancel the spell if he makes a successful RR (he gets one every 10 minutes). If either body is killed, both “souls” will be affected as by an Absolution.

sp-00834.description_en: As Demonic Possession I, except target only gets an RR once every 10 minutes.

sp-00835.description_en: Part of the target's “soul” is taken and placed in an organic object on the caster's person. The body of the target will act as the caster directs whenever he concentrates. The spell is canceled when: the caster cancels it or the object is destroyed or the target is more than 100' from object or the object leaves caster's person. If the caster is not concentrating the target is free to do anything he wants (though he is at -30 to all actions). While being commanded, the target is aware of all the actions he is performing (but he is helpless to stop them).

sp-00836.description_en: Part of the target's soul is transferred to a random object somewhere within 100 miles. The target is at -30 to all activities until the spell is dispelled or he touches the object. The target will always know the direction of his “soul.”

sp-00837.description_en: As Demonic Possession I, except target only gets an RR once every hour.

sp-00838.description_en: Target flees in total panic from caster. Fleeing equates to movement away for d10 rounds at maximum pace.

sp-00839.description_en: As Word of Panic, except affects all within 20' of caster.

sp-00840.description_en: As any single 10th level or lower spell on this list, except with a range of 300'.

sp-00841.description_en: The target is put into a state of deep sleep from which he will not awaken or age. He will only die if his body is killed. This sleep will continue until dispelled or until a single, non-magical event (specified by the caster at the time of casting) is accomplished. Note that the caster must specify the non-magical condition (i.e., it is not an option).

sp-00842.description_en: As Subjugation, except the “soul” is only released if the caster cancels the spell or the object is destroyed or the target touches the object.

sp-00843.description_en: As Transferral, except the caster can operate at 90% of normal activity, and the target can only make an RR once every hour.

sp-00844.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] Target's “soul” is torn from the target's body; it remains in whatever place “souls” go, for 30 days per 10 failure. The soul can be returned early only through Lifegiving. The target is unconscious and at -75 for subconscious activities (including all healing and subconscious spells) while his soul is absent.

sp-00845.description_en: As Absolution, except “soul” can only be brought back through Lifegiving.

sp-01000.description_en: The caster can attune himself to a small animal to serve as his familiar. The caster must obtain the animal through normal means (can be no more than 10% of the caster's own mass) and cast this spell on the animal once per day for one week (concentrating for 2 hours each day). The caster can then control the familiar and view the world through its senses by concentrating on it (though the familiar must be within 50' per level). If the animal is killed, the caster will have a -25 modification to all actions for 2 weeks.

sp-01001.description_en: Caster can instantly summon a first level creature that he can control. If the creature can understand the caster's communication (e.g., Animal Tongues), the creature can be controlled by normal communication. Otherwise, control is maintained through concentration of the caster. The general type of creature can be specified by the caster, but exactly what creature is summoned should be determined by the GM (select from creatures commonly found in the area where the spell is cast). If the creature was summoned to be used for a task that is not dangerous to the creature, the duration for this spell is 10 minutes per level of the caster. However, if the creature is ever put into a dangerous situation, the duration drops to 1 round per level of the caster.

sp-01002.description_en: This spell is cast upon the caster's familiar. However, the familiar must be a type of animal that is usually associated with “evil” (e.g., a reptile, a bat, a raven, etc.). This spell transfers part of the caster's “life” into the familiar. This spell must be cast upon the familiar every day for a month (concentrating for 2 hours a day). The familiar retains all of its old abilities and it gains special abilities. The familiar will become a malformed version of the animal it once was (more grotesque). The caster can view the world through the senses of the creature at a range of 250' per level. The creature's AT changes to 4, and it gains a +10 to its DB and OB. The caster can cast spells through the familiar as if the caster were exactly where the familiar is (this includes casting “self” spells on the famliar—the range for this ability is 50' per level). The creature will make all of its RRs at half the caster's level (or its own level,

sp-01003.description_en: As Summons I, except caster can also choose one of the following options: a) the level of the summoned creature is increased by one, b) an extra first level is summoned, or c) the duration can be doubled.

sp-01004.description_en: Caster can bind one creature (animal intelligence, up to second level). The bound creature must follow the commands of the caster (the caster does not have to concentrate). The caster can only have as many creatures bound as he has levels. If the creature is ever outside the range of the spell, the spell is dispelled.

sp-01005.description_en: As Summons II, except it has 2 options.

sp-01006.description_en: The target of this spell is any creature (animal intelligence, up to second level) that has been bound (with a Binding spell). The caster can give a simple, straightforward task for the creature to attempt to complete. The creature will do its best to complete the task (within the duration of the spell). When the duration of this spell expires, the creature returns to its “unbound” status.

sp-01007.description_en: As Summons II, except it has four options.

sp-01008.description_en: As Binding II, except binds up to a 5th lvl creature.

sp-01009.description_en: As Summons II, except it has six options.

sp-01010.description_en: The target of this spell is a familiar that has had Investiture I successfully cast upon it. This spell puts more of the caster into his familiar. The caster must cast this spell once per day for six months (for 2 hours each day). The caster can use the famliar's sense up to 1,000 feet per level away; can cast spells through the familiar up to 200' per level away; the creature's AT improves to 11; its gets a DB bonus of +20 (to the original DB); it gets an OB bonus of +30 (to the OB); gains a poisonous attack that is used in conjunction with its normal attack (bite, sting, etc.); makes RRs at three quarters the caster's level or its own level (whichever is higher); its appearance continues to become more grotesque (assuming the nature of the caster—it may not be recognized as the animal-type that it once was). If the familiar dies, the caster loses half his Power Points and Hits for 1-5 weeks.

sp-01011.description_en: As Summons II, except it has nine options.

sp-01012.description_en: As Binding II, except binds up to a 10th level creature.

sp-01013.description_en: As Summons II, except it has eleven options.

sp-01014.description_en: As Order Bound II, except affects up to a 10th lvl creature.

sp-01015.description_en: As Summons II, except it has fourteen options.

sp-01016.description_en: As Binding II, except binds a 15th level creature.

sp-01017.description_en: As Summons II, except it has sixteen options.

sp-01018.description_en: As Investiture II, except familiar becomes even more part of the caster. Investiture II must already have been completed, then the caster must cast this spell once per day for one year (for 2 hours each day). Caster can use the familiar's senses up to 1 mile per level away; can cast spells through the familiar up to 1,000' per level away; the creature's AT improves to 12; it gets a DB bonus of +30 (to the original DB); it gets an OB bonus of +50 (to the original OB); gains a minor breath weapon attack (in addition to its normal attacks); makes its RRs at the caster's level (or its own, whichever is higher); its form becomes completely grotesque and could not be associated with the animal it once was. However, if the familiar dies, the caster loses three quarters of his Power Points and Hits for 1-5 weeks.

sp-01019.description_en: As Summons II, except has nineteen options.

sp-01020.description_en: As Binding II, except binds any creature.

sp-01021.description_en: As Order Bound II, except affects any level creature.

sp-01022.description_en: Caster can use any lower level spell on this list, once per round.

sp-01023.description_en: Creates an area of up to 20'R about the point touched. The darkness is equal to the darkest night. If the point is on a mobile target, it will move with the target. See Section 7.1.7.

sp-01024.description_en: Target can see 100' in normal darkness as if it were day.

sp-01025.description_en: Caster can vary the intensity of darkness in the area, but he cannot lighten it past its natural state.

sp-01026.description_en: As Darkness II, except radius is 100'.

sp-01027.description_en: As Nightvision, except caster can see in all darkness (even magical).

sp-01028.description_en: As Dark Control II, except range and radius are 50'.

sp-01029.description_en: Caster can create either the visual illusion of shadowy figures, or real shadows (as many as the caster's level); they will move when he concentrates. See Section 7.1.27 for more on illusions.

sp-01030.description_en: As Darkness II, except radius is 300'.

sp-01031.description_en: Creates a 20'R area of darkness. No nonmagic light can exist and magic light (except Utterlight) must make a RR or be cancelled.

sp-01032.description_en: As Dark Control II, except range and radius are100'.

sp-01033.description_en: As Dark Vision, except the target can see as far as he would be allowed in daylight.

sp-01034.description_en: As Lesser Utterdark, except radius is 100'.

sp-01035.description_en: As Darkness II, except radius is 500'.

sp-01036.description_en: Creates a “cloud” of darkness that has a 100'R and drifts with the wind. The darkness can vary in intensity from an overcast day to the dark of night.

sp-01037.description_en: As Nightvision, except affects a number of targets equal to caster's level.

sp-01038.description_en: As Lesser Utterdark, except area of effect is 200'.

sp-01039.description_en: As Darkvision, except affects a number of targets equal to caster's level.

sp-01040.description_en: As Clouds of Darkness I, except for area of effect.

sp-01041.description_en: As Darkness II, except radius is 1,000'.

sp-01042.description_en: As Lesser Utterdark, except radius is 300'.

sp-01043.description_en: As Darkness II, except radius is 100' per level of the caster.

sp-01044.description_en: As Clouds of Darkness I, except radius is 1 mile per level of the caster.

sp-01067.description_en: Turns 100 cubic feet of ice into water vapor.

sp-01068.description_en: Turns 10 cubic feet of earth into fine dust.

sp-01069.description_en: Any previous cracks or flaws within a section of any normal material 1,000 cubic feet (10'x10'x10') will extend to their limit. See Section 7.1.7.

sp-01070.description_en: Turns 10 cubic feet of stone into fine powder.

sp-01071.description_en: As Un-Ice I, except affects up to 1,000 cubic feet.

sp-01072.description_en: Turns 1 cubic foot of any inorganic material to fine powder (must be one object).

sp-01073.description_en: As Earth to Dust I, except affects up to 100 cubic feet.

sp-01074.description_en: Can shatter an inorganic object, up to 1 cubic foot in volume; all within 5' take an 'A' Impact critical, holder takes a 'C' Impact critical. Metal objects get a +30 RR modification.

sp-01075.description_en: As Powder Stone I, except affects up to 100 cubic feet.

sp-01076.description_en: As Un-Ice I, except affects up to 100 cubic feet per level of the caster.

sp-01077.description_en: As Disruption I, except affects up to 10 cubic feet.

sp-01078.description_en: As Earth to Dust I, except affects up to 1,000 cubic feet.

sp-01079.description_en: Causes cracks to appear in up to 100 cubic feet of non-metal, inorganic material.

sp-01080.description_en: As Powder Stone I, except affects 1,000 cubic feet.

sp-01081.description_en: Completely disintegrates 1 cubic feet of inorganic material.

sp-01082.description_en: As any single spell (10th level or lower) from this list, except with a range of 300'

sp-01083.description_en: As Disintegration I, except affects 10 cubic feet.

sp-01084.description_en: As Earth to Dust I, except affects up to 100 cubic feet per level of the caster

sp-01085.description_en: As Powder Stone I, except affects up to 100 cubic feet per level of the caster

sp-01086.description_en: As Disruption I, except up to as many objects (up to 1 cubic foot each) as the caster's level can be affected, and range is 100'.

sp-01087.description_en: As Disintegration I, except affects objects up to 100 cubic feet and range is 300'.

sp-01088.description_en: Target feels pain, and he takes 20% of his remaining hits.

sp-01089.description_en: Target has one of his physical stats (characteristics) temporarily lowered by d10. Only the temporary stat is lowered. Physical stats include Strength, Agility, Quickness, Constitution, Presence, and Self Discipline (one is selected at random). When the duration expires, the stat will go back up by the same amount that it went down (with a maximum of whatever the potential for the stat is).

sp-01090.description_en: As Pain, except the ache seems natural and reduces target's hits by 10% until cured (caster must specify nature of ache). The target is unaware that the spell has been cast on him, because it affects him gradually (target loses 1 hit per minute). The GM should describe the ache as a natural thing (and may choose not inform the player that the character has reduced hits).

sp-01091.description_en: As Pain, except target takes 40% of his remaining hits.

sp-01092.description_en: As Impair I, except affects temporary and potential stats.

sp-01093.description_en: As Impair I, except decrease is 3d10.

sp-01094.description_en: As Ache, except target's hits are reduced by 20%.

sp-01095.description_en: As Pain, except target takes 60% of his remaining hits.

sp-01096.description_en: As Trait Erosion I, except decrease is 2d10.

sp-01097.description_en: As Impair I, except decrease is 5d10.

sp-01098.description_en: As Ache, except target's hits are reduced by 40%.

sp-01099.description_en: As Pain, except as many targets as the caster's level can be affected.

sp-01100.description_en: As Pain, except target takes 90% of his remaining hits.

sp-01101.description_en: As Trait Erosion I, except decrease is 3d10.

sp-01102.description_en: As Impair I, except affects a number of targets equal to the caster's level.

sp-01103.description_en: As Fire Nerves, except affects a number of targets equal to the caster's level.

sp-01104.description_en: As Trait Erosion I, except affects a number of targets equal to the caster's level.

sp-01105.description_en: As Impair I, except decrease is 10d10.

sp-01106.description_en: As Agony, except as many targets as the caster's level can be affected.

sp-01107.description_en: As Trait Erosion I, except decrease is 5d10.

sp-01108.description_en: As Trait Erosion I, except one physical stat is reduced to 1.

sp-06701.description_en: Caster can attempt to avoid one missile shot fired at him. The missile must be in his field of vision when the spell is cast. The caster gets a bonus of +50 to his DB against this attack.

sp-06702.description_en: As Anticipate Missile, except applies to one melee attack that the caster is aware of.

sp-06703.description_en: When faced with a choice about which he has little or no information (e.g., which corridor leads outside the quickest) the caster may cast this spell and the Gamemaster will determine which way he goes, biasing the choice favorable by 25% (e.g, roll 1-100: correct on 26-100, incorrect on 01-25).

sp-06704.description_en: Caster can avoid one spell cast on him. The caster gets a bonus of +50 to his DB against a directed elemental attack; his normal DB against an area elemental attack; or the caster's BAR suffers a -10 penalty (on all other spell attacks).

sp-06705.description_en: Caster gains a vision of what will probably happen in the next minute if he takes a specified action.

sp-06706.description_en: Caster is aware of any being within the area of effect that has hostile intentions towards him. The hostility must be directed specifically at the caster or the spell reveals nothing. The being's hostility must be active (i.e., driving the being to perform aggressive actions), not passive (i.e., hate exists, but no action is planned).

sp-06707.description_en: Caster has a dream relating to a topic decided upon just before retiring. This spell can only be used once per night. The caster must sleep a minimum of one normal sleep cycle.

sp-06708.description_en: Caster has a vision of what has occurred in a room or place; limited to up to 1 minute per level into the past. The size of the room is limited to the area of effect.

sp-06709.description_en: Predicts most probable actions of a being in the next round; specifics are not learned (e.g., attack in melee, cast a spell; but no detail on attack target or what spell). This results in the caster being able to declare his statement of intent for the round after hearing what the target has decided to do. Note that the target is free to change his declared action with the requisite penalties.

sp-06710.description_en: As Intuitions I, except caster gets to gaze 2 minutes into the future.

sp-06711.description_en: As Room Feel I, except limit is 1 hr/lvl.

sp-06712.description_en: As Anticipate Hostility, except for area of effect, duration and range.

sp-06713.description_en: As Dream I, except limit is 2 dreams/night on different topics.

sp-06714.description_en: As Anticipations, except if action is to cast a spell, the spell to be cast and target are learned.

sp-06715.description_en: As Room Feel I, except limit is 1 day/lvl.

sp-06716.description_en: As Dream I, except limit is 3 dreams/night on different topics.

sp-06717.description_en: As Room Feel I, except limit is 1 week/ lvl.

sp-06718.description_en: As Intuitions I, except time limit extends 1 min/lvl into the future.

sp-06719.description_en: As Anticipations, except caster can predict actions of all beings within 100' of him.

sp-06720.description_en: As Dream I, except limit is 5 dreams/night on any combination of topics the caster chooses.

sp-06721.description_en: As Anticipations True, except spell types and targets are learned.

sp-06722.description_en: Caster adds +20 to his DB versus one missile fired at the caster. The caster must be able to see the attack.

sp-06723.description_en: As Turn Missile, except applies to a melee attack.

sp-06724.description_en: Creates an invisible force shield in front of the caster; it subtracts 25 from melee and missile attacks and functions as a normal shield.

sp-06725.description_en: Deflects one missile fired at the caster; that missile has 100 subtracted from its attack (caster must be able to see the attack).

sp-06726.description_en: As Deflect I, except its effect is against one melee attack.

sp-06727.description_en: As Deflect I, except missile automatically misses.

sp-06728.description_en: Creates a pocket of still air 1" per level on all sides of the caster, that no outside gas can come into. The duration of the spell is how long it will take for one person to consume all the oxygen inside the pocket.

sp-06729.description_en: As Deflect I, except affects 2 missiles.

sp-06730.description_en: Deflects one elemental spell against caster. The attack roll has -50 added to it (must be in the caster's field of vision).

sp-06731.description_en: As Bladeturn I, except affects 2 melee attacks.

sp-06732.description_en: As Deflect I, except affects 3 missiles.

sp-06733.description_en: As Spell Deflect I, except affects 2 elemental attack spells.

sp-06734.description_en: As Bladeturn I, except affects 3 melee attacks.

sp-06735.description_en: As Spell Deflect I, except affects 3 elemental attack spells.

sp-06736.description_en: As Deflect I, Bladeturn I, and Spell Deflect I; except any 3 attacks can be deflected.

sp-06737.description_en: Beam of light (like a flashlight) springs from the caster's palm. This beam has a 50' effective range. When hand is made into a fist, the light will “shut off” until the fist is opened again.

sp-06738.description_en: Causes a small, 1" diameter point of light that will glow softly. This spell provides enough light for Nightvision to work properly; but not enough light to allow much mobility in the dark. See Section 7.1.19.

sp-06739.description_en: Lights a 10'R area about the point touched. If the point is on a mobile object or being, it will move with the object/ being. See Section 7.1.19.

sp-06740.description_en: Causes a bright aura about the caster, making him appear more powerful and subtracting 5 from all attacks.

sp-06741.description_en: [RR Mod: -10] Causes a 10'R sphere of intense light. All within are stunned for 1 round per 10 failure.

sp-06742.description_en: A bolt of intense, charged light is shot form the palm of the caster. Results are determined on the Shock Bolt Attack Table.

sp-06743.description_en: As Light, except a 10'R of normal darkness is created.

sp-06744.description_en: As Self Aura, except it makes him appear extremely powerful and subtracts 15 from all attacks.

sp-06745.description_en: As Light I, except radius is 50'.

sp-06747.description_en: Causes any object up to 1000 cubic feet to glow with any desired color.

sp-06748.description_en: Ray of light of any color springs from caster's hand. This ray can be up to 5 miles long.

sp-06749.description_en: As Darkness, except radius is 100' per level.

sp-06750.description_en: As Light, except radius is 100' and it is equivalent to full daylight. All magically created darkness is nullified for the duration.

sp-06751.description_en: Darkens a 100'R, no non-magical light can exist in the area and magic light (except for Utterlight) must make a RR or it is canceled.

sp-06752.description_en: Focuses sunlight as a lens, must be focused initially on a fixed point. After 1 round it can be moved at a rate of 1' per round. It will burn through a 1' diameter at a rate of 1' per round (for wood), 4" per round (for stone), or 1" per round (for metal). This spell cannot be used effectively in combat (as foes can easily move out of the way). However, if used on an immobile foe, see Hand of Fire for damage resolution process.

sp-06753.description_en: As Sunfires, except doesn't need sunlight.

sp-06754.description_en: As Sunfires, except the range and focus is 6" from open palm of caster (caster's arm is immune) and it can be moved 10' per round. It can be used in melee; striking on the Fire Bolt Attack Table (deliver double concussion hits) with an OB equal to (30 + caster's directed spell skill bonus with Hand of Fire). If the attack is fumbled (01-02 UM), the caster takes an automatic 'C' Heat Critical.

sp-06755.description_en: As Hand of Fire, except doesn't need sunlight.

sp-06756.description_en: Causes caster to appear blurred to attackers, subtracting 10 from all attacks.

sp-06757.description_en: Caster and objects on his person appear to be a shadow; and thus are almost invisible in dark areas (e.g., in many situations this could be handled with a Stalking/Hiding bonus between 25 and 75).

sp-06758.description_en: A single object is made invisible (1 garment, 1 naked body, etc.); until 24 hrs pass or the object is struck by a violent blow (being hit by a weapon, falling, etc.) or the object makes a violent move (i.e., an attack).

sp-06759.description_en: [RR Mod = -50] Target makes an RR. Failure results in the caster being invisible to the target; others see the caster normally. If the caster makes an obvious action (e.g., talking, moving an object, etc.), the target may make another RR (the GM may deem it appropriate to apply modifiers to this RR based upon the action the caster takes). If the caster attacks the target, he may make another RR with a +50 modifier. If the caster begins to concentrate (50% activity), he can extend the duration of this spell indefinitely (as long as he can concentrate).

sp-06760.description_en: A limited illusion that allows the caster to look like any humanoid figure within 20% of his own size.

sp-06761.description_en: As Cloaking I, except the caster can affect 3 targets (the caster makes one BAR that applies to all targets).

sp-06762.description_en: As Cloaking I, except every target in the area of effect must make a RR (one BAR a round for all targets). Once a target makes a successful RR, he need not make another RR against the spell.

sp-06763.description_en: As Cloaking I, except the caster can affect 5

sp-06764.description_en: As Cloaking Sphere I, except for the area of effect.

sp-06765.description_en: Creates a duplicate of the caster; if he concentrates, it will move as he wills; otherwise, it does exactly as he does. The duplicate is limited to moving within in the area of effect. If the caster concentrates, he can “merge” the duplicate with himself and then split back apart again (making it difficult to discern which one is the “real” caster).

sp-06766.description_en: As Facades I, except illusion may include sounds and voices.

sp-06767.description_en: As Cloaking I, except the caster can affect 10 targets (the caster makes one BAR that applies to all targets).

sp-06768.description_en: As Cloaking Sphere I, except for the area of effect.

sp-06769.description_en: Caster appears to be offset from where he really is. All attacks have no effect 10% of the time (no normal RRs). Each time a foe misses him, the chance of “no effect” for that foe goes down by 5%.

sp-06770.description_en: Caster and objects on his person take on the visual texture, color, and form of surrounding area. Caster is nearly invisible when motionless (+200 to all Hiding maneuvers) and has a +50 bonus to Stalking attempts (if he concentrates). This spell is not cumulative with Shadow.

sp-06771.description_en: As Cloaking I, except the caster can affect 20 targets (the caster makes one BAR that applies to all targets).

sp-06772.description_en: As Displacement I, except “no effect” chance is 20%.

sp-06773.description_en: As Cloaking Sphere I, except for the area of effect.

sp-06774.description_en: As Shadow Mentalist I, except there are two duplicates.

sp-06775.description_en: As Displacement I, except “no effect” chance is 30%.

sp-06776.description_en: As Camouflage, except doesn't require concentration while moving and the Stalking bonus is 75.

sp-06777.description_en: As Cloaking I, except the caster can affect as many targets as he has levels and the range is only limited to the caster's field of vision.

sp-06778.description_en: Caster is protected from natural heat up to 170˚F (treat as if target were in 70˚F temperature). For temperatures above 170˚F, subtract 100˚F to determine the effective temperature for the target. Caster also receives +20 to all RRs versus heat spells and heat attacks (+20 DB versus elemental fire and heat attacks).

sp-06779.description_en: Caster is protected from natural cold down to 20˚F (treat as if target were in 70˚F temperature). For temperatures below 20˚F, add 50˚F to determine the effective temperature for the target. Caster also receives +20 to all RRs versus cold spells and cold attacks (+20 DB versus elemental cold and cold attacks).

sp-06780.description_en: Caster is able to sustain an additional 25% of his total concussion hits (round off) before passing out. Hits are still taken and remain when the duration expires.

sp-06781.description_en: Relieves 1 round's worth of accumulated stun.

sp-06782.description_en: Delays the effect of a poison as long as the caster concentrates.

sp-06783.description_en: As Unpain I, except 50% additional hits may be sustained.

sp-06784.description_en: As Stun Relief I, except 3 rounds are relieved.

sp-06785.description_en: Has a 50% chance of neutralizing a poison (modified by potency of the poison) if the caster is unconscious or concentrates for one hour. In any case, it delays the poison for as long as the caster can concentrate.

sp-06786.description_en: Will awaken the caster from any unnatural sleep (e.g., Sleep spell, sleeping drug, etc.). Caster takes one round to awaken.

sp-06787.description_en: As Unpain I, except 75% additional hits may be sustained.

sp-06788.description_en: As Heat Resistance, except caster is immune to natural heat and takes 50% normal damage from heat spells.

sp-06789.description_en: As Cold Resistance, except caster is also immune to natural cold and takes 50% normal damage from cold spells.

sp-06790.description_en: As Unpain I, except 100% additional hits may be sustained.

sp-06791.description_en: As Neutralize Poison, except chance of neutralization is 100% (modified).

sp-06792.description_en: As Awake, except there is no delay and it can be used with normal sleep and set to be triggered by any activity (e.g., attack, danger, etc.).

sp-06793.description_en: As Unpain IV, except caster ignores all pain. He will be active until he takes more than: [2 x normal hits + Temporary Constitution]. He ignores all penalties due to wounds (i.e., negative modifications to actions). When he exceeds this limit, he does not pass out; he dies from system shock.

sp-06794.description_en: Caster receives basic idea of item's purpose, if any.

sp-06795.description_en: Detects power in an object, but not what realm or how much; caster may concentrate on a different object each round.

sp-06796.description_en: Gives a general idea of the place of origin of an item.

sp-06797.description_en: Detects if a curse is on an item.

sp-06798.description_en: Gives the origins of an item's power.

sp-06799.description_en: Gives details of where, when, and how the examined piece of rock was worked.

sp-06800.description_en: Gives a vision of a significant event in the item's past.

sp-06801.description_en: Gives significant details about an item's construction and purpose (not specific powers).

sp-06802.description_en: Caster gets a vision up to 1 hour per level into the past. The desired time can be set within ±30 min. The vision must be associated with an item or place. The vision can last up to 1 minute per level if the caster concentrates and remains inactive.

sp-06803.description_en: Gives major abilities and powers of an item.

sp-06804.description_en: Gives a vision of how someone died and an image of their killer. This spell must be cast within 24 hours of the death. In addition, this spell must be cast at the place of death or in the presence of the dead body.

sp-06805.description_en: When cast just before a Past Vision spell, it allows caster to lock onto a specific event in an item's past, and then examine that event with a Past Vision.

sp-06806.description_en: Gives a complete rundown on an item's construction, powers, and purpose (may be modified if an item is extremely powerful).

sp-06807.description_en: As Past Vision I, except time range is 1 day per level (with an error of ±1 hour) and the vision can last up to 10 minutes per level.

sp-06808.description_en: As Past Vision I, except time range is 1 month/lvl (with an error of ±1 day) and the vision can last up to 1 hour per level.

sp-06809.description_en: As Past Vision I, except time range is 1 year per level (with an error of ±1 week) and the vision can last up to 5 hours per level.

sp-06810.description_en: As Past Vision I, except time range is 10 year per level (with an error of ±1 month) and vision can last up to 10 hours per level (each hour of the past event takes only 10 minutes real time).

sp-06811.description_en: Detects any active spell or item from the Mentalism realm; caster can concentrate on a 5'R area each round.

sp-06812.description_en: As Detect Mentalism, except realm is Essence.

sp-06813.description_en: As Detect Mentalism, except realm is Channeling.

sp-06814.description_en: As Detect Mentalism, except caster can detect extremes of emotion (e.g., hatred, love, sadness, etc.). In addition, the caster learns which emotions the target is feeling is extreme. If there are no extremes of emotion (i.e., only normal feelings), this spell detects nothing.

sp-06815.description_en: As Detect Mentalism, except detects all invisible things; all attacks against something so detected are at -50. See Section 7.1.10.

sp-06816.description_en: As Detect Mentalism, except detects if a being is evil or an item created by evil or long used by a very evil person.

sp-06817.description_en: As Detect Mentalism, except that it gives a 75% chance of detecting a trap (trap sophistication modifiers may reduce or enhance this chance). See Section 7.1.29.

sp-06818.description_en: As Detect Mentalism, except it will give an estimate of the power (i.e., level) of the person or item or spell examined.

sp-06819.description_en: As Detect Mentalism, except it analyzes general spell type (in item or cast) and what list is was cast from. In the case of a person it gives the person's profession.

sp-06820.description_en: As Perceive Power I, except range is 100' and area is 10'R.

sp-06821.description_en: As Detect Invisible, except caster can see invisible things anywhere he can normally see. In addition, his attacks suffer no penalties against invisible targets he can see.

sp-06822.description_en: As Detect Mentalism, except detects any spells that have ever been cast in the area examined. The caster will know the spell type and the list it was cast from.

sp-06823.description_en: As above, except range is 500' and area is 50'R.

sp-06824.description_en: As Power Typing, except exact spell type is known for every spell thrown in the area.

sp-06825.description_en: As above, except range is 1 mile and area of effect is 300'R.

sp-06826.description_en: Gives the direction and distance to any specific object or place that the caster is familiar with or has had described in detail.

sp-06827.description_en: As Detect Mentalism, except any of the lower level “detect” spells can be used, one per round.

sp-06828.description_en: Any or all of the lower level non-Location spells on this list may be used simultaneously.

sp-06829.description_en: Makes an inanimate object (up to 1000 cubic feet) appear to be 10' to one side of its actual location.

sp-06830.description_en: Creates any simple immobile image or scene up to 10'R or any constant (including repetitive) sounds coming from a 10'R.

sp-06831.description_en: Creates a simple immobile image or scene up to an area of 10'R. One of the following options may also be chosen: a) sound can be added to the illusion or b) the duration can be doubled or c) the range can be doubled or d) the radius of effect can be doubled. Note that all parts of the area of effect must be within the range of the spell.

sp-06832.description_en: Creates the image of one object or being, that will move however the caster wants while he concentrates. When the caster stops concentrating the image remains, but stops moving (the caster can resume concentration later and resume moving the phantasm). The image can be any size that would fit into a 10'R sphere.

sp-06833.description_en: This spell may only be cast on one inanimate object of up to 10 pounds per level of the caster. The spell alters the visual appearance of the object, concealing its true appearance.
