sp-06423.description_en: As Venom, except converts the poison into a contact poison (a poison that affects its victim upon contact with the victim's skin—regardless of its normal method of affecting the target).

sp-06424.description_en: The caster can transfer a single does of a poison in any target he is touching into any other target within range of the spell.

sp-06425.description_en: The caster can ingest a single dose of a poison. For the duration of this spell, he will be unaffected by the poison. Anytime before the duration expires, the caster can attempt to transfer the poison to a single target. The target must be no further away than 5' and the caster's mouth must be capable of delivering the poison (either through a kiss, a whisper, spitting, etc.). The target gets an RR to avoid the effects of this spell (in addition to the RR for the poison).

sp-06426.description_en: As Venom's Breath, except the caster can transfer the poison to any single target within the range. The caster must be able to cast an obvious, evil glare at the target. The target gets an RR to resist the effects of this spell (in addition to the RR for the poison).

sp-06427.description_en: The caster can disperse a poison into a misty cloud. The size of the mist is 1'R per dose of the poison used. The poison will linger in the area normally until the duration of the spell expires (i.e., the mist will be subject to wind, etc.). When the duration expires, the poison disperses.

sp-06428.description_en: As Venom's Glare, except for the range.

sp-05511.description_en: Target suffers a -30 modification for all actions.

sp-05512.description_en: Target is incapable of making decisions or initiating action. He may continue to fight current foes or in selfdefense.

sp-05513.description_en: Target suffers a -100 OB modification for missile attacks, and a -50 modification for all other actions.

sp-05514.description_en: Target fears caster and attempts to flee. Fleeing normally equates to moving at maximum pace away from the caster.

sp-05515.description_en: Target becomes unbalanced. If he is moving, he trips and falls (0% action for 1-5 rnds). If he is performing a maneuver, the manuever fails.

sp-05516.description_en: Target fumbles any weapon or item in his hands. Roll on the appropriate Arms Law Fumble Table.

sp-05517.description_en: Target sees a nonexistent foe and must fight him until the foe is “defeated” (i.e., takes damage that would drop the him). The foe has the same capabilities as target but does him no damage (i.e., always misses).

sp-05518.description_en: Target is spun about a few times, and stops facing 180˚ away from his original facing. He spends the round attempting to recover.

sp-05519.description_en: Target's weapon is altered to appear to him that it is some other similar weapon. When fighting with this weapon, he can only use the category bonus for his OB (i.e., the weapon is similar, but not the same).

sp-05520.description_en: Target sees all moving things clearly, but the caster can control the fixed scene that the target “sees.”

sp-05522.description_en: Target sees moving things displaced between 6" and 18" from where they really are. Any attack he makes against a moving foe has a 50% chance of having no effect.

sp-05523.description_en: A number of targets equal to the caster's level can be distracted as in Distraction (all targets must all be in the caster's field of vision).

sp-05524.description_en: As Fear, except the spell is instantaneous and the duration is 1 minute per 5 failure.

sp-05525.description_en: Target has amnesia, but loses none of his skills or abilities. He will forget his background and other memories (GM's discretion).

sp-05526.description_en: As Confusion, except the spell is and instantaneous all beings within a 50'R are targets.

sp-05527.description_en: As any single spell from this list of 10th level or lower, except the range is increased to 300'.

sp-05528.description_en: As Fear, except the spell is instantaneous and the duration is one round per 5 failure and all beings within a 50'R are targets.

sp-05529.description_en: As any single spell from this list of 10th level or lower, except affects up to 20 targets.

sp-05530.description_en: As Amnesia, except duration is permanent (unless dispelled).

sp-05531.description_en: Target sees and hears a world in which everything real has an image, but the image is changed or distorted (e.g., a Dwarf might seem to be an Orc, a house might seem to be a cave, etc.). The caster has no control over this reality.

sp-05532.description_en: As any single spell from this list of 20th level or lower, except the range is increased to 300' and will affect up to 20 targets at once.

sp-05533.description_en: Condenses once cubic foot of water from the surrounding air into the caster's hands. The caster can then funnel the water into any available receptical.

sp-05534.description_en: Creates 10'x10'x3' wall of dense air. This wall reduces all movement through it by 50%. In addition, all attacks through the wall suffer a -50 penalty.

sp-05536.description_en: Creates a 5'R near vacuum, all in radius take a 'A' Impact critical, as air leaves and rushes back in.

sp-05537.description_en: Stops all generalized air movement (e.g., wind) up to 30 mph and cuts stronger winds by 30 mph.

sp-05538.description_en: As Fog I, except the area of effect is 100'.

sp-05539.description_en: As Airwall, except has a fixed duration of 1 minute per level.

sp-05540.description_en: A bolt of fire is shot from the palm of the caster. Attack is resolved on the Fire Bolt Table (a fire source must be within 10').

sp-05541.description_en: As Vacuum A, except results in a 'B' Impact critical.

sp-05542.description_en: As Airstop I, except the area of effect is 50'.

sp-05543.description_en: As Fog I, except the area of effect is 300'.

sp-05544.description_en: All gas within 10'R of the caster is converted to normal, breathable air.

sp-05545.description_en: As Vacuum A, except results in a 'C' Impact critical.

sp-05546.description_en: Creates a 50'R of high oxygen content air. All within receive a +20 bonus to their OBs and all fire attacks deal double damage.

sp-05547.description_en: Creates a whirlwind about caster. The whirlwind moves with the caster and has a 10'R. No missile attacks can penetrate it and any movement or melee (except for caster's) into or through it is cut by 80%.

sp-05549.description_en: As Vacuum A, except results in a 'D' Impact critical.

sp-05550.description_en: Allows the caster to change the direction of the wind within the radius.

sp-05551.description_en: As Fog, except duration is 1 hour per level and area of effect is 100' per level.

sp-05552.description_en: As Vacuum, except causes an 'E' Impact critical.

sp-05553.description_en: Caster has complete control of clouds within range (includes fog). He can control storm clouds and cause them to rain, but he cannot create them.

sp-05554.description_en: May transmute 1000 cubic of gas (no part can be more than 20' away) into another non-magical gas that the caster has a sample of. This spell takes 8 hours of uninterrupted concentration.

sp-05555.description_en: Causes caster to appear blurred to attackers, subtracting 10 from all attacks.

sp-05556.description_en: A single object is made invisible (1 garment, 1 naked body, etc.) until 24 hrs pass, the object is struck by a violent blow (being hit by a weapon, falling, etc.), or the object makes a violent move (i.e., an attack).

sp-05557.description_en: The caster and objects on his person appear to be a shadow. Thus, they are almost invisible in dark areas. In many situations this could be handled with a Stalking/Hiding bonus between +25 and +75.

sp-05558.description_en: Any sounds originating within a 1'R of the caster's body are completely muffled. This results in a +25 bonus to Stalking.

sp-05559.description_en: As Unseen I, except everything within 1' of the target is invisible as long as it is within the 1'R and none of the Unseen termination conditions occur. See Section 7.1.10.

sp-05560.description_en: As Invisibility I, except the caster can vary the radius up to 1'.

sp-05561.description_en: Creates a 1000 square foot screen on which the caster can place any static scene. The scene seems 3-dimensional and normal.

sp-05562.description_en: Caster appears to be offset from where he really is, all attacks have no effect 10% of the time (no normal RRs). Each time a foe misses him, the chance of “no effect” for that foe goes down by 5%.

sp-05563.description_en: As Invisibility I, except caster is also undetectable by smell and sound.

sp-05564.description_en: Creates a duplicate of the caster. If the caster concentrates, it will move as he wills; otherwise, it does exactly as he does. With a round of concentration, the caster can merge the shadow mystic with himself and then split apart again.

sp-05565.description_en: As Invisibility I, except radius is 10'.

sp-05566.description_en: As Displacement I, except base chance of missing is 20%.

sp-05567.description_en: Caster is flattened until he has only two dimensions. Thus, he can slide through cracks (and can't be seen from the side).

sp-05568.description_en: Caster can merge into any inanimate, solid material. While merged, the caster cannot move or perceive. When the caster emerges, he can emerge from any side or face of the material. The caster caster cannot move “through” any material greater in width than his own body size plus 2 feet.

sp-05569.description_en: Caster has no “presence” (for the purposes of presence detection spells).

sp-05570.description_en: As Displacement I, except base chance of missing is 30%.

sp-05571.description_en: Caster can pass through 1' per level of any inorganic material at the rate of 2' per minute.

sp-05572.description_en: As Merging, except caster may turn within the material and perceive the world outside the material if within 6" of the surface.

sp-05573.description_en: As Displacement I, except base chance of missing is 40%.

sp-05574.description_en: Caster and objects on his person cannot be detected by any “Detect ...”

sp-05575.description_en: As Displacement I, except base chance of missing is 50%.

sp-05576.description_en: Caster can “Merge” into a material, use “Unpresence,” use “Nondetect” and observe surrounding activity; all with this one spell.

sp-05577.description_en: For each level of the caster, 1 cubic foot of liquid can be heated to boiling or cooled to freezing (at the rate of 50˚ per round of concentration).

sp-05578.description_en: As Boil/Freeze Water, except removes all sediment and dissolved substances.

sp-05579.description_en: As Boil/Freeze Water, except 1000 cu'/ lvl of liquid is evaporated at a rate of 100 cu'/rnd.

sp-05580.description_en: Creates a 10'x10'x1' wall of churning water (a water source must be within 10'). All attacks through the wall suffer a -80 penalty. All movement through the wall is reduced by 80%.

sp-05581.description_en: A bolt of water is shot from the palm of the caster (a water source must be within 10'). Attack is resolved on the Water Bolt Attack Table.

sp-05582.description_en: Creates a corridor through liquid up to 100' long, 3' wide and 10' deep (must be open at the top).

sp-05583.description_en: Causes it to rain in 100'R about the caster. The heaviness of the rain is determined by the humidity (GM's discretion).

sp-05584.description_en: All water within a 100'R is calmed. Waves are cut by 20' in the center and less towards the perimeter. This will negate the effects of currents in the area of effect.

sp-05585.description_en: Creates a wave moving away from the caster; wave is 1' high per level in the center and 10' per level wide.

sp-05586.description_en: As Waterwall, except has a fixed duration of 1 minute per level of the caster.

sp-05587.description_en: As Water Corridor I, except limit is 300'x4'x50' deep.

sp-05588.description_en: Changes any liquid into normal water.

sp-05589.description_en: Creates a 20'R whirlpool that will draw in any unpowered objects up to 200' away. Powered objects may make a Very Hard manuever roll to resist the pull of the Whirlpool.

sp-05590.description_en: Creates a tunnel through liquid that is 5' in diameter and 100' long.

sp-05591.description_en: As Calm Water, except area of effect is 100' per level and waves are cut by 50'..

sp-05592.description_en: The area of effect for this spell is the water immediately surrounding the boat that the caster is on. For as long as the caster concentrates, the speed of the boat will be increased by 50' per round (approximately 3 miles per hour).

sp-05593.description_en: Creates a bubble of air (10' R) around the caster and others. The bubble will carry them in up to 100' of water (air is resuscitated). The caster must concentrate to move the bubble (without concentration it will simply rise to the surface). At the end of the duration, the bubble will begin to rise to the surface. All objects inside the bubble will rise with it. After reaching the surface, the bubble will burst.

sp-05594.description_en: As Water Bolt, except for range.

sp-05595.description_en: As Water Corridor, except limit is 100' per level long, 6' wide and 100' deep (and does not require concentration).

sp-05596.description_en: As Water Tunnel, except limit is 6' diameter and 100' per level long (and does not require concentration).

sp-05597.description_en: Caster can divert a water source or part of a water source into a stream which can be up to 15'x6' and as long as the range of this spell.

sp-05598.description_en: May transmute 1 cubic foot of liquid into another non-magical liquid that the caster has a sample of. This spell takes 8 hours of continuous, uninterrupted concentration.

sp-05599.description_en: Caster studies and memorizes the appearance and mannerisms of a being, for later use in a Face Shifting or Change type spell. The caster can only have as many forms studied as he has levels.

sp-05600.description_en: Allows caster to alter the form of his face. If he has used Study Form on a being he can take on that being's exact form.

sp-05601.description_en: Caster can alter his entire body to the form of another humanoid race (no increase in mass). This cannot be a specific person. See Section 7.1.11.

sp-05602.description_en: Caster appears to be of any race he chooses to magical or mental detections.

sp-05603.description_en: Caster can increase his mass (and usually height) by 10% per level of the caster. However, there is no proportional increase in strength (other than for movement purposes).

sp-05604.description_en: As Enlarge, except caster shrinks by 10% per level (to a maximum of 90%) and there is no proportional decrease in strength.

sp-05605.description_en: As Misfeel Kind, except profession may be misrepresented.

sp-05606.description_en: Caster can breathe water, air, or gas at will (though only one at a time).

sp-05607.description_en: As Change To Kind, except caster can assume any organic form within 1/2 and 2x his mass. The caster does not obtain any special abilities. See Section 7.1.11.

sp-05608.description_en: [RR Mod: -50] Caster can speak mentally with any sentient being; and to the being it will seem as if the caster was speaking in the being's own language.

sp-05609.description_en: As Misfeel Kind, except level can be misrepresented (ranging from first level to twice his actual level).

sp-05610.description_en: As Change, except a specific being can be duplicated if the being has been Studied.

sp-05611.description_en: As Misfeel Kind, except target appears to have no presence.

sp-05612.description_en: Allows caster to use all of the “Misfeel” spells at once.

sp-05613.description_en: As Change, except caster can alter forms at will, by concentrating for one round/change.

sp-05614.description_en: As Change to Kind, except for duration.

sp-05616.description_en: As Misfeel, except caster does not have to concentrate.

sp-05617.description_en: As Impersonation Change, except for duration.

sp-05618.description_en: As Impersonation Change, except will last until the caster cancels the spell (or it is dispelled).

sp-05619.description_en: As Misfeel, except caster can misrepresent his presence and power, so that he seems to be a minor deity.

sp-05620.description_en: Caster develops an entire false persona and places his own persona deep in his subconscious. To all detection attempts (except, perhaps, Mind Probe), the caster seems to be the false persona. The caster has no control over his actions, until the set duration is over. The false persona can be a specific person if “Study Form” has been cast once/day (for 30 days) on that person.

sp-05621.description_en: For each level of the caster, warms 1 cubic foot of any solid, inanimate material up to 100˚F at a rate of 1 cubic foot per round of concentration (without further concentration the material will remain at its current temperature for the remainder of the duration).

sp-05622.description_en: As Warm Solid except temperature limit is 500˚F. In addition, caster must concentrate for 1 round to raise the temperature 50˚F (up to the maximum). Caster need only touch the target when the spell is cast.

sp-05623.description_en: As Warm Solid, except it can cool down to 0˚F.

sp-05624.description_en: Any previous cracks or flaws in material up to 10'x10'x10' section will extend to their limit.

sp-05625.description_en: Can cause a door to expand or contract due to subtle temperature changes. Door can be jammed or loosened (+50 to -50 on attempts to break down the door).

sp-05626.description_en: Causes any wood to ignite and burn. All woo dignited must be within 1' of caster's palm.

sp-05627.description_en: As Heat Solid I, except the range is 50'

sp-05628.description_en: As Chill Solid, except the range is 50' and the temperature decreases 50˚F each round that the caster concentrates (down to a minimum of -200˚F).

sp-05629.description_en: Creates a 10'x10'x(2' at base, 1' at top) transparent wall of ice. It can be melted or chopped through or toppled (if not against a solid surface). Requires a source of water within 10'.

sp-05630.description_en: Creates a doorway through any solid, inanimate material. The Doowary can be up to 3'x6'x1'.

sp-05631.description_en: Will turn 100 cubic feet of stone to packed earth, or 100 cubic feet of earth to mud, or 100 cubic feet mud to earth, or 100 cubic feet of earth to stone.

sp-05632.description_en: Causes a non-metal, inanimate object to shatter (up to 1 cubic foot in size). All within 5'R take an 'A' Impact critical (anyone holding the object takes a 'C'). Metal objects get a +30 RR modification.

sp-05633.description_en: As Solid Door I, except size is 4'x8'x5'.

sp-05634.description_en: By molding with his hands, caster may shape 1 cubic foot of solid, inanimate material as if it were putty or clay. At the end of the spell's duration, the stone will harden to normal consistency.

sp-05635.description_en: 1 cubic foot of any solid, inanimate material becomes very brittle. This causes the object to break if struck (the GM may rule that certain objects get an RR to resist breakage).

sp-05636.description_en: Disintegrates (i.e., nothing is left of) the target 100 cubic feet of stone.

sp-05637.description_en: As Unstone, except affects 1 cubic foot of metal.

sp-05638.description_en: Creates a tunnel through solid, inanimate material that is 4' in diameter and 5' per level long.

sp-05639.description_en: As Solid Door, except size is 6'x12'x10'.

sp-05640.description_en: As Solid Tunnel, except that it is permanent and size is 3'x6'x(1' per level).

sp-05641.description_en: May transmute 1 oz. of any solid material into another non-magical solid material that the caster has a sample of. This spell takes 8 hours of continues, uninterrupted concentration.

sp-06048.description_en: The target's memory of a 20 minute period is blanked. After a period of up to 1 hour (specified by the caster at the time of casting), the target will remember all that transpired during the period.

sp-06049.description_en: Target forgets 10 contiguous minutes totally, caster's choice.

sp-06050.description_en: Target's mind is temporarily blank and he can do nothing. The target will remember nothing that occurs during the period. His body stops (all voluntary actions cease).

sp-06051.description_en: As Forget I, except 100 minutes can be erased.

sp-06052.description_en: As Mental Block I, except up to 1 hour of memories can be delayed for up to 24 hours.

sp-06053.description_en: As Mind Blank I, except duration is 3 rounds.

sp-06054.description_en: As Forget I, except 200 minutes can be erased.

sp-06055.description_en: Target's mind is blanked as in Mind Blank I, at random, for 10 contiguous minutes each and every day.

sp-06056.description_en: Target loses 5% of his collected experience (usually experience points).

sp-06057.description_en: As Mental Block I, except memories of up to 1 hour/level can be delayed for up to 1 day per level.

sp-06058.description_en: As Mind Blank I, except duration is 5 rounds.

sp-06059.description_en: As Forget I, except 1 hour per level of the caster can be erased.

sp-06060.description_en: As Mind Death I, except the target blanks out twice per day.

sp-06061.description_en: As Mind Death I, except the target blanks out three times per day.

sp-06062.description_en: As Mind Blank I, except duration is 10 rounds.

sp-06063.description_en: As Lost Experience I, except percentage lost is 10%.

sp-06064.description_en: As Mind Death I, except target blanks out five times per day.

sp-06065.description_en: As Lost Experience I, except loss is 15%.

sp-06066.description_en: As Mind Death I, except target blanks out ten times per day.

sp-06067.description_en: As Mind Blank I, except the target has a 5% chance of blanking out each round.

sp-06068.description_en: Target has trouble sleeping. He is has a -25 to all actions after suffering this for 2 days (until cured).

sp-06069.description_en: Target has a dislike for a specific type of thing the caster chooses. The target has a 50% (modified by the three times the target's Self Discipline bonus) chance of maintain control around the subject. If the the target fails to control himself around the subject, roll d100 (not open-ended) to determine how the target must react to the subject. A result of 1 results in the target blindly attacking the subject (attempting to destroy it at all costs). A result of 2-11 results in the target fleeing from the subject (moving at maximum pace to get away from it). A result of 12 or more results in the target avoiding the subject at all costs.

sp-06070.description_en: Target becomes guilty over some incident in his past. He will not perform such an action again, and must take steps to overcome the guilt (rectifying the past wrong).

sp-06071.description_en: Target believes everyone except his close associates are out to get him.

sp-06072.description_en: As Insomnia, except target will panic and flee in any personally dangerous situation.

sp-06073.description_en: Target has a fear of a specific type of thing the caster chooses. The target has a 25% (modified by the three times the target's Self Discipline bonus) chance of maintain control around the subject. If the the target fails to control himself around the subject, roll d100 (not open-ended) to determine how the target must react to the subject. A result of 1-25 results in the target fleeing from the subject (moving at maximum pace to get away from it). A result of 26 or more results in the target avoiding the subject at all costs.

sp-06074.description_en: The target has a tendancy to hallucinate and see things as they aren't. For each major event in a day, the target has a 10% chance of hallucinating and seeing major threats as nothing major and minor things as major threats (similar to the syndrome that Don Quixote suffered from).

sp-06075.description_en: Target develops a second personality of another “alignment.” There is a 10% chance per day that the second personalty will become active (at a random time during the day). The GM should randomly select d10 role traits that must be extremely different from the target's.

sp-06076.description_en: Target has a psychosis about a specific type of thing the caster chooses. The target has a 10% (modified by the three times the target's Self Discipline bonus) chance of maintain control around the subject. If the the target fails to control himself around the subject, roll d100 (not open-ended) to determine how the target must react to the subject. A result of 1-5 results in the target blindly attacking the subject (attempting to destroy it at all costs). A result of 6-55 results in the target fleeing from the subject (moving at maximum pace to get away from it). A result of 56 or more results in the target avoiding the subject at all costs.

sp-06077.description_en: Target drifts in and out of a catatonic state. Every hour there is a 25% chance he will become catatonic for one hour.

sp-06078.description_en: As Insomnia, except target can only sleep if he uses drugs or spells (e.g., a sleep spell). He adds +100 to his RRs against all sleep spells. If he gets no sleep, he will slowly go mad (GM's discretion on the specifics).

sp-06079.description_en: Target has an extreme dislike for a specific type of thing the caster chooses. The target has a 25% (modified by the three times the target's Self Discipline bonus) chance of maintain control around the subject. If the the target fails to control himself around the subject, roll d100 (not open-ended) to determine how the target must react to the subject. A result of 1-10 results in the target blindly attacking the subject (attempting to destroy it at all costs). A result of 11-60 results in the target fleeing from the subject (moving at maximum pace to get away from it). A result of 61 or more results in the target avoiding the subject at all costs.

sp-06080.description_en: As Guilt, except every day that he fails a normal RR, the target must take actions to atone for his guilt incident (or sink into a deep depression).

sp-06081.description_en: As Paranoia, except target believes that everyone is out to get him (even his close associates).

sp-06082.description_en: As Greater Paranoia, except target will not associate with anyone for longer than one hour per day.

sp-06084.description_en: Target has an extreme psychosis for a specific type of thing the caster chooses. The target has a 0% (modified by the three times the target's Self Discipline bonus) chance of maintain control around the subject. If the the target fails to control himself around the subject, roll d100 (not openended) to determine how the target must react to the subject. A result of 1-20 results in the target blindly attacking the subject (attempting to destroy it at all costs). A result of 21 or more results in the target fleeing from the subject (moving at maximum pace to get away from it).

sp-06085.description_en: As Schizophrenia, except the second personality is active 50% of the time.

sp-06086.description_en: As Schizophrenia, except the target developes d10+1 extra personalities (i.e., Multiple Personality Disorder). There is a 10% chance per day that a non-active personality will become active.

sp-06087.description_en: As Catatonia, except every hour there is a 95% chance target will be catatonic.

sp-06088.description_en: Target may be given any mental disease that the caster chooses.

sp-06089.description_en: Target is distracted by an imaginary object. For the duration of this spell, the target is limited to 70% activity each round.

sp-06090.description_en: Caster and target are locked in mental contact until: the caster cancels the spell or the spell is dispelled or either the caster or the target has a RR failure of 30 or greater (both the caster and the target must make RRs each other every round). The one failing by 30 becomes unconscious. While this spell is active, neither the caster nor the target can take any action.

sp-06091.description_en: As Mind Lock, except target is frozen in mental combat with the caster. The target is unable to take any actions, but caster may perform 50% of his normal activity.

sp-06092.description_en: Target is controlled by a Type I Demon (level 1-2, see Section 7.1.31). The target may make an additional RR once per day (attack level equals Demon level) to regain control. The Demon is random, maniacal, and homicidal.

sp-06093.description_en: Target's “soul” and the caster's “soul” are interchanged; the caster can operate at 50% of his normal activity while in the body of the target. The target (in the caster's body) is inactive. The caster can cancel the spell at any time (takes one round). The target can cancel the spell if he makes a successful RR (he gets on every 10 minutes). If either body is killed, both “souls” are destroyed.

sp-06094.description_en: Target must obey the caster. If the caster gives an order to do something completely alien to the target, he may make another RR with a +25 modification.

sp-06095.description_en: As Demonic Possession I, except Demon is Type II.

sp-06096.description_en: As Domination, except target is a zombie until he succeeds in his once per day RR. On any round that the caster concentrates, the target must obey him.

sp-06097.description_en: As Mind Slave, except target's “mind/ essence/soul” is in agony and any round that the caster doesn't concentrate, the target will obey anyone's verbal commands. Conflicting commands mean the target does nothing.

sp-06098.description_en: As Demonic Possession I, except Demon is Type III.

sp-06099.description_en: As Domination, except the target must perform a single, straight forward task.The task may take the target out of range of the caster and he must still attempt to complete the task.

sp-06100.description_en: As Waiting Domination, except only gets a RR once per week.

sp-06101.description_en: As Demonic Possession I, except Demon is Type IV.

sp-06102.description_en: As Mind Slave, except caster need not concentrate to command the target.

sp-06103.description_en: As Demonic Possession I, except Demon is Type V.

sp-06104.description_en: As Transferral, except target only gets his additional RRs once per month and every time he fails his chance to successfully resist decreases by 1 (and caster's percentage activity in the target's body raises by 1%).

sp-06105.description_en: As Banishment, except target only gets his RRs once per month and every time he fails his chance to successfully resist decreases by 1.

sp-06106.description_en: Target has one of his mental stats (determine randomly) temporarily lowered by d10. The temporary stat is lowered, not the potential. The mental stats are: Presence, Empathy, Intuition, Memory, Reasoning, and Self Discipline. When the duration expires, the stat will go back up by the same amount that it went down (with a maximum of whatever the potential for the stat is).

sp-06107.description_en: Target is mentally bewildered. Each round, he has only a 50% chance of making a decision. He will always defend himself from direct attack.

sp-06108.description_en: The target immediately loses 10% of his remaining power points (PPs). They may be recovered normally (i.e., usually after a sleep period).

sp-06109.description_en: As Dull Mind I, except decrease is 2d10.

sp-06110.description_en: As Dull Mind I, except decrease affects a potential stat and the corresponding temporary stat.

sp-06111.description_en: As Power Leak I, except decrease is 20%.

sp-06112.description_en: As Dull Mind I, except decrease is 3d10.

sp-06113.description_en: As Power Leak I, except decrease is 30%.

sp-06114.description_en: As Dull Mind I, except decrease is 4d10.

sp-06115.description_en: As Mind Erosion, except decrease is 2d10.

sp-06116.description_en: As Power Leak I, except decrease is 40%.

sp-06117.description_en: As Dull Mind I, except decrease is 5d10.

sp-06118.description_en: As Power Leak I, except decrease is 50%.

sp-06119.description_en: As Dull Mind I, except decrease is 6d10.

sp-06120.description_en: As Mind Erosion, except decrease is 3d10.

sp-06121.description_en: As Power Leak I, except decrease is 60%.

sp-06122.description_en: As Mind Erosion, except decrease is 4d10.

sp-06123.description_en: As Power Leak I, except decrease is 70%.

sp-06124.description_en: As Dull Mind I, except decrease is 8d10.

sp-06125.description_en: As Dull Mind I, except decrease is 10d10.

sp-06126.description_en: As Mind Erosion I, except decrease is 5d10.

sp-06127.description_en: As Mind Erosion I, except one mental stat is reduced to 1.

sp-06128.description_en: All text that the target reads will appear jumbled (and is indecipherable).

sp-06129.description_en: The target believes that he is very ill (or sicker than he actually is). The GM should base the severity of the “imaginary” illness upon the amount the target fails his RR by (e.g., if he fails his RR by more than 50, he might think he is terminally ill).

sp-06130.description_en: The target will perceive something incorrectly through one of his senses. For example, he might see something out of the corner of his eye, or hear something that isn't there. The sensory effect cannot last longer than one round.

sp-06131.description_en: The target's perception is skewed. All perception rolls are modified by -10 (this includes orientation rolls).

sp-06132.description_en: The target is attacked by a creature of shadow. The creature is actually an mental illusion and only the target sees the creature. The creature will immediately attack the target (in melee). The creature has an AT of 1; but has the same DB, OB, and Hits as the target (use the target's highest melee OB as the creature's OB). If the caster casts spells upon himself (e.g., Haste), the creature acts as if affected by the same spell. The creature is immune to spell attacks. If the creature is slain (by killing or incapacitating it), the spell is canceled.

sp-06133.description_en: The target will view things as if he were in a dream. His reactions are slowed (he suffers a -10 to all actions). In addition, he will sometimes perceive things differently than they actually are. The GM should roll for each event that occurs with a 10% chance that the event is mistaken. For example, the target might see an approaching horse as a large wild animal; or he might see the charging Orc as a messenger bringing news. Note that the caster has no control over what the target perceives or how he perceives it.

sp-06134.description_en: The target will believe that the next person he sees is someone else. At the time of casting, the caster choose what type of person the target sees. For example, he might see a servant entering the palace gate instead of the skulking figure. If the next person attacks the target, the effects of this spell are canceled.

sp-06135.description_en: As Misleading I, except penalty is -30.

sp-06136.description_en: As False Sense I, except affects up to 2 senses and the effect can last for up to 2 rounds.

sp-06137.description_en: As Lesser Phantom, except the creature has an AT of 3.

sp-06138.description_en: As Waking Dream I, except actions suffer a -20 penalty, and the chance of perceiving things incorrectly is 20%.

sp-06139.description_en: As Misleading I, except penalty is -50.

sp-06140.description_en: As False Sense I, except affects up to 3 senses and the effect can last for up to 3 rounds.

sp-06141.description_en: As Mistaken Identity I, except the target mistakes the next person he sees for a specific person. For example, he might see the Chamberlain entering the throne room, instead of a burglar.

sp-06142.description_en: As Lesser Phantom, except the creature has an AT of 11.

sp-06143.description_en: As False Sense I, except affects up to 4 senses and the effect can last for up to 4 rounds.

sp-06144.description_en: As Misleading I, except penalty is -70.

sp-06145.description_en: As Waking Dream I, except actions suffer a -30 penalty, and the chance of perceiving things incorrectly is 30%.

sp-06146.description_en: As False Sense I, except affects up to 5 senses and the effect can last for up to 5 rounds.

sp-06147.description_en: As Lesser Phantom, except the creature has an AT of 12.

sp-06148.description_en: As Misleading I, except penalty is -100.

sp-06149.description_en: As Mistaken Identity I, except the target will permanently confuse the next person he sees with someone else. Each time he sees that person, there is a 50% chance that he will mistaken them for someone else.

sp-06150.description_en: As Waking Dream III, except for the duration and the target suffers a -40 to all actions, and the chance of perceiving things differently is 40%.

sp-06151.description_en: Target suspects the actions of his associates (GM may give descriptions that arouse the player's own suspicions).

sp-06152.description_en: One of the target's personal traits is perverted (one trait is taken to an extreme). See Rolemaster Standard System for a complete discussion of role traits. Note that the character may have a middle of the road trait (i.e., neither thrifty or frivolous) that is taken to an extreme.

sp-06153.description_en: On any statement there is a 20% chance the target lies.

sp-06154.description_en: As Trait Subversion I, except 2 traits may be perverted.

sp-06155.description_en: Target will attempt to cheat on all matters (e.g., splitting loot, card games, etc.)

sp-06156.description_en: The target has urges to commit minor property damage. When such an opportunity arises, there is an 60% chance the target must attempt to commit such damage.

sp-06157.description_en: Target becomes a kleptomaniac and has a 10% chance of attempting to steal anything that catches his fancy (if it does not involve violence).

sp-06158.description_en: As Trait Subversion I, except 3 traits may be perverted.

sp-06159.description_en: The target has a fascination with burning things. Every day there is a 20% chance that he must try to burn something. He will burn things that do not result in injury to people or animals (though there is a 1% chance that he will injure himself in the attempt to burn things).

sp-06160.description_en: As Stealing, except target will use violence to steal.

sp-06161.description_en: As Trait Subversion I, except 5 traits may be perverted.

sp-06162.description_en: As Trait Subversion I, except a different trait will affected each day (with the previous day's trait reverting back to its normal state).

sp-06163.description_en: There is a 5% chance target will assault any given person when he initially encounters him (the target must actually meet the person—this procludes people travelling in the street).

sp-06164.description_en: As Pyromania, except target doesn't care if people (or animals) are injured. There is a 5% chance that he will injure himself in the attempt.

sp-06165.description_en: As Trait Subversion I, except 7 traits may be perverted.

sp-06166.description_en: As Random Trait Subversion I, except 2 traits are affected at one time.

sp-06167.description_en: As Assault, except there is a 10% chance that the target will attempt to maim any given person.

sp-06168.description_en: As Trait Subversion I, except 10 traits may be perverted.

sp-06169.description_en: As Random Trait Subversion I, except 3 traits are affected at one time.

sp-06170.description_en: As Assault, except target attempts to kill.

sp-06171.description_en: As Assault, except target will take note of a person and plan to assassinate him later. This spell will last until the target has made an assassination attempt on the target.

sp-06172.description_en: As Trait Subversion I, except it is permanent.

sp-06173.description_en: As Suspicion, except whenever the target is injured, suffers humiliation, or fails in something, he will attempt suicide in some imaginative way.

sp-08932.description_en: Allows the caster to research enchanted abilities to be placed in items.

sp-08933.description_en: As Empathy, except “low intelligence” can be enchanted.

sp-08934.description_en: Allows the caster to enchant a +5 bonus (magical) into a weapon.

sp-08935.description_en: As Weapon I, except armor and shields can be enchanted.

sp-08936.description_en: As Weapon I, except general type magic items with bonuses can be enchanted. Also, items like spell adders and spell multipliers are described in Section 8.6.1.

sp-08937.description_en: As Empathy, except “medium intelligence” can be enchanted.

sp-08938.description_en: As Weapon I, except +10 bonuses can be enchanted.

sp-08939.description_en: As Armor I, except +10 bonuses can be enchanted.

sp-08940.description_en: As General I, except +10 bonuses can be enchanted.

sp-08941.description_en: As Empathy, except “high intelligence” can be enchanted.

sp-08942.description_en: As Weapon I, except +15 bonuses can be enchanted.

sp-08943.description_en: As Armor I, except +15 bonuses can be enchanted.

sp-08944.description_en: As General I, except +15 bonuses can be enchanted.

sp-08949.description_en: As Weapon I, except +20 bonuses can be enchanted.

sp-08950.description_en: As Armor I, except +20 bonuses can be enchanted.

sp-08951.description_en: — As Empathy, except “very high intelligence” can be enchanted.

sp-08952.description_en: As General I, except +20 bonuses can be enchanted.

sp-08558.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster will gain the ability to work iron.

sp-08559.description_en: As Work Iron, except steel can be worked (to make +5 nonmagic items).

sp-08560.description_en: As Work Iron, except any single normal metal other than iron and steel can be worked (if the material would make an item with no bonuses).

sp-08561.description_en: As Work Iron, except certain alloys can be worked. Items made from these alloys will have no bonuses.

sp-08562.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster can make steel from iron. The amount that can be made in a day depends on the available equipment.

sp-08563.description_en: As Work Steel I, except steel can be worked to make +10 nonmagic items.

sp-08564.description_en: As Make Steel, except alloys of normal metals may be made if the component metals are available.

sp-08565.description_en: As Work Iron, except the caster can work stone if, for some reason, he wishes to make a stone item.

sp-08566.description_en: As above, except allows working of alloys that could create up to +15 nonmagic items.

sp-08567.description_en: As Work Iron, except allows caster to work jewels.

sp-08569.description_en: As Work Iron, except allows caster to work any inorganic mineral that would create an item with a +20 bonus (Mithril is an example of this).

sp-08570.description_en: As Work Iron, except caster can work any inorganic material that would make +25 items (Laen is a superhard volcanic glass that could be used in a world system to fit this description).

sp-08571.description_en: As Work Iron, except caster can work any inorganic material that would make +30 items. (Eog is an extremely dense, hard metal that is very difficult to work and find; it could be used to fit this description.)

sp-08572.description_en: Allows caster to make and work any metal, alloy, or inorganic mineral (e.g., Kregora is an alloy that has intense anti-Essence, anti-Channeling and anti-Mentalism properties, it could only be worked through the use of this spell).

sp-08573.description_en: Allows caster to work with non-magic liquids.

sp-08574.description_en: Allows caster to make one dose of a potion that can have a first level spell imbedded in it. The caster must also cast an Imbed spell to place the spell into the potion.

sp-08575.description_en: Allows caster to safely handle, prepare, and process minor poisons.

sp-08576.description_en: As Work Liquid, except allows caster to work with nonmagic gas.

sp-08577.description_en: As Potion I, except up to a second level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08578.description_en: As Potion I, except up to a third level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08579.description_en: As Minor Poison, except works with all but the most deadly poisons.

sp-08581.description_en: As Potion I, except up to a fourth level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08583.description_en: As Potion I, except up to a fifth level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08584.description_en: As Potion I, except up to a seventh level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08585.description_en: As Potion I, except up to a ninth level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08586.description_en: As Potion I, except up to a tenth level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08587.description_en: As Major Poison, except works with all poisons.

sp-08588.description_en: As Potion I, except allows a Potion # spell to be used to create multiple doses. For example, a Potion V could be used to create 5 doses of a first level spell, or 1 dose of a 3rd lvl spell and 1 dose of a 2nd or 2 doses of a 2nd lvl spell and 1 dose of a 1st or etc.

sp-08589.description_en: As Potion I, except up to a twentieth level spell can be imbedded.

sp-08678.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster may work nonmagic wood.

sp-08679.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster can make a sheet of paper that will hold one first level spell. Creation takes one week per level of spell that the rune paper can hold.

sp-08680.description_en: As Work Wood, except cloth may be worked.

sp-08681.description_en: As Rune Paper I, except paper will hold up to a second level spell.

sp-08682.description_en: Allows the caster to make a “wand.” Note that this spell does not put any spells into the wand; it simply creates the physical object.

sp-08683.description_en: As Work Wood, except allows caster to work ordinary organic material.

sp-08684.description_en: As Rune Paper I, except paper will hold up to a third level spell.

sp-08686.description_en: As Make Wand, except a “rod” can be made.

sp-08689.description_en: As Rune Paper I, except paper will hold up to a tenth level spell.

sp-08690.description_en: As Make Wand, except a “staff” can be made.

sp-08691.description_en: As Rune Paper I, except paper will hold up to a thirteenth level spell.

sp-08693.description_en: As Rune Paper I, except paper will hold up to a sixteenth level spell.

sp-08695.description_en: As Work Organic, except any organic material can be worked (e.g., this might be required to work the skins of dragons or other “enchanted” creatures).

sp-08696.description_en: As Rune Paper I, except paper will hold up to a twentieth level spell.

sp-08697.description_en: As Work Wood, except magic wood may be worked.

sp-08698.description_en: As Rune Paper I, except paper will hold any level spell.

sp-05778.description_en: Caster may mentally speak with another Astrologer.

sp-05779.description_en: Caster may mentally speak with any thinking being.

sp-05781.description_en: As Mind Voice I, except range is 300'.

sp-05782.description_en: As Star Voice, except caster may speak to another Astrologer as far as the horizon if it is clear and night (500' at any other time).

sp-05783.description_en: As Mind Voice I, except range is 500'.

sp-05785.description_en: As Mind Voice I, except range is 1000'.

sp-05787.description_en: On a clear night outdoors caster may interchange thoughts with a willing target. If both are Astrologers, the two may interchange power points.

sp-05789.description_en: As Mind Voice I, except caster leaves a message of 25 words or less, set to be triggered by a specific mental pattern (known through Mind Store:) or a time limit.

sp-05791.description_en: As Mind Voice I, except range is one mile. The target must be located by Finding or other means.

sp-05792.description_en: As Star Merge, except caster and target must have merged before and the range is up to horizon, outdoors on a clear night (100' at any other time).

sp-05797.description_en: Caster an cause his voice to be heard at a point up to 100' per level away (in amplified tones). If the location is out of sight, the caster must have been there.

sp-05798.description_en: As Mind Voice I, but range is 1 mile per level.

sp-05799.description_en: As Mind Voice I, except range is unlimited.

sp-05800.description_en: As Lord Voice, except range is unlimited.

sp-05801.description_en: Caster (on a clear night, when stars are visible) gains perfect directional and distance sense. For the duration of this spell, he will always know where he is in relation to known landmarks.

sp-05802.description_en: Caster has a dream relating to a topic decided upon just before retiring. The caster must sleep for a normal sleep cycle (minimum of 4 hours) for this spell to work).

sp-05803.description_en: Gives a general idea of the place of origin of an item.

sp-05804.description_en: Caster knows whether a text is cursed, what language it is in, and other general information; but only understand basic concepts of it.

sp-05805.description_en: Gives a vision of a significant event in the item's past.

sp-05806.description_en: As Dreams I, except limit is 2 dreams per night on different topics.

sp-05809.description_en: As Dreams I, except limit is 3 dreams per night on different topics.

sp-05810.description_en: Caster receives (usually from his patron deity) a “yes” or a “no” to a question on a single topic. This spell may be used a maximum of once per day.

sp-05812.description_en: As Origins, but caster gets clear vision of the location of origin of an item, including creator and approximate date.

sp-05815.description_en: As Commune I, except caster receives answers to three questions.

sp-05818.description_en: As Dream I, except limit is 5 dreams per night on any combination of topics the caster chooses.

sp-05819.description_en: As Commune I, except caster can receive a more detailed answer (e.g., a name or short phrase) to a question involving only 1 concept.

sp-05820.description_en: As Dream I, except caster is able to manipulate his dream in a limited way to gain more information on a specific topic. For example, while he is in the dream he can ask a question (but there is no guarantee it will be answered).

sp-05821.description_en: Caster receives detailed information from his deity on a single topic question.

sp-05822.description_en: Beam of light (like flashlight) springs from the caster's palm (with a 50' effective range). If the caster closes his hand (into a fist), the light will “turn off.” If the fist is opened before the duration expires, the light will “turn on.”

sp-05823.description_en: Generates a bright aura about the caster, making him appear more powerful and subtracting 5 from all attacks.

sp-05824.description_en: Lights a 20'R area about the point touched. If the point is on a mobile target, it will move with the target.

sp-05825.description_en: [RR Mod: -10] Causes a 10'R sphere of intense light, all within are stunned for 1 round per 10 failure.

sp-05826.description_en: A bolt of intense, charged light is shot form the palm of the caster. The attack is resolved on the Shock Bolt Attack Table.

sp-05829.description_en: A 6" R ball of light is shot from the palm of the caster. It will travel to the limit of the range, explode (as a flare), burn with a bright light (as a flare), drift slowly to earth, and go out. An area equal to the range is lit if the flare can raise to its full range. The flare drops 10' per round. If fired at a target, resolve the attack as a Shock Bolt that delivers Heat criticals.

sp-05831.description_en: A ray of light (any color) springs from caster's palm. This ray can be up to 5 miles long.

sp-05832.description_en: As Light, except that the range is 100' and caster may generate a single source of up to 60'R or three 20'R sources

sp-05835.description_en: As Self Aura, except spell subtracts 15 from all attacks.

sp-05836.description_en: Brilliant flash blinds target for 1 round per 10 failure.

sp-05841.description_en: Caster is illuminated in a blinding light. All within 10' suffer must resist as in Blinding. All attacks against the caster subtract 25.

sp-05842.description_en: Focuses star or moonlight as a lens, must be focused initially on a fixed point. After 1 round it can be moved at the rate of 1' per round. It will burn through a 1' diameter at a rate of 6" per round (in wood), 1" per round (in stone), or 0.5" per round (in metal).

sp-05843.description_en: As Starfires, except the range and focus is 6" from open palm of caster (caster is immune) and it can be moved at the rate of 10' per round. It can be used in a combat, striking as a Fire Bolt with an OB of 30 (plus the caster's directed spell bonus with Starhand). Concentration is not required if being used in melee.

sp-05844.description_en: As Starfires or Starhand, but star/moonlight is not required.

sp-05868.description_en: Caster is aware of the presence of all sentient/ thinking beings within his range.

sp-05870.description_en: Gives the direction and distance to any specific object or place that the caster is familiar with or has had described in detail.

sp-05872.description_en: Caster stores mental pattern of target. This information can be used later to recognize the target or locate the target through Finding.

sp-05873.description_en: Caster gets direction and distance to any one unshielded Mind Stored target within range.

sp-05876.description_en: Caster learns the race, the profession, and the level of target.

sp-05877.description_en: Caster gets direction to any unshielded Mind Stored target within range.

sp-05880.description_en: As Presence, plus a general knowledge of the actions of each being (e.g., being is casting a spell, but not what spell is being cast).

sp-05882.description_en: As Finding, but both the caster and target must be outdoors while stars are visible.

sp-05887.description_en: As Location, except range is 20 miles.

sp-05888.description_en: As Direction, except no range limitations.

sp-05889.description_en: As Finding, except no range limitations.

sp-05890.description_en: As Finding True, except Caster can 'track' target for the next 24 hours without further power point expenditure (though he must concentrate). He simply needs to concentrate for a round to determine current distance and direction.

sp-05891.description_en: Caster is able to communicate basic ideas in a specific language (hungry, thirsty, bathroom, peace, etc.). For the duration of this spell, the caster has the equivalent of skill rank 2 in the language.

sp-05892.description_en: Target must answer one single concept question.

sp-05895.description_en: As Speech I, except caster can communicate in more complex concepts, although there is a good chance of misinterpretation. For the duration of this spell, the caster has the equivalent of skill rank 4 in the language.

sp-05897.description_en: Caster can broadcast his thoughts to minds within the area of affect.

sp-05898.description_en: Target will follow a single suggested act that is not completely alien to him (e.g., no suicide suggestions, no blinding himself suggestions, etc.).

sp-05899.description_en: As Speech I, except caster is reasonably fluent in the language. Caster's accent is imperfect, but there is only a slight chance of misinterpretation. For the duration of this spell, the caster has the equivalent of skill rank 6 in the language.

sp-05900.description_en: Target is forced to obey caster as in Suggestion, for as long as caster concentrates and speaks to the target. Caster can concentrate on this spell and a Speech spell at the same time.

sp-05901.description_en: As Minor Mind Speech, except range is 100'.

sp-05904.description_en: As Minor Mind Speech, except range is 300'.

sp-05905.description_en: Target is forced into complete inaction for that round (the caster must command the target to stop).

sp-05909.description_en: As Speech, except caster is absolutely fluent, has an accent as a native, and has complete idiomatic knowledge of language. For the duration of this spell, the caster has the equivalent of skill rank 4 in the language.

sp-05910.description_en: Everyone within the area of effect, is stunned for 1 round per 10 failure (the caster is immune).

sp-05911.description_en: As Mind Speech, except caster can limit broadcast to desired beings.

sp-05912.description_en: Target is forced to obey caster in all things, including suicide and similar actions.

sp-05665.description_en: Caster gets a vision of what will happen in the next minute if he takes a specified action.

sp-05667.description_en: As Intuitions I, except caster gets to gaze 3 minutes into the future.

sp-05668.description_en: Caster has a dream relating to a topic decided upon just before retiring. The caster must sleep for a normal sleep cycle (minimum of 4 hours) for this spell to work).

sp-05669.description_en: As Intuitions I, except caster gets to gaze 5 minutes into the future.

sp-05670.description_en: Predicts most probable action of a being in the next round. The target must declare one of his actions for the next round, before the caster declares his action. The target is free to change his action, but must suffer the penalties for changing actions once the round has begun. If the target's action includes affecting someone else, the caster does not gain that information (e.g., the target would have to reveal that he was attacking, but not who he was attacking). If the target's action includes casting a spell, he only has to reveal the Type of spell being cast, not the actual spell (e.g., the target would have to reveal that he is casting a Force spell, but not that he is casting a Sleep V).

sp-05672.description_en: As Dreams I, except limit is 2 dreams per night on different topics.

sp-05673.description_en: As Anticipation, except if action is to cast a spell, the exact spell and target are learned.

sp-05674.description_en: As Intuitions I, except caster gets to gaze 10 minutes into the future.

sp-05675.description_en: As Dreams I, except limit is 3 dreams per night on different topics.

sp-05677.description_en: As Anticipations I, except caster can either predict the actions of three beings for the next round or the actions of one being for the next three rounds.

sp-05679.description_en: As Intuitions, except caster gets to gaze 1 minute per level into the future.

sp-05684.description_en: As Anticipations I, except actions of 5 beings may be predicted or the actions of one being for the next five rounds.

sp-05685.description_en: As Dream I, except limit is 5 dreams per night on any combination of topics the caster chooses.

sp-05686.description_en: As Anticipation I, except caster can predict actions of all beings within 100' of him.

sp-05687.description_en: As Anticipations True, except spell type and target are known as well as the actions.

sp-05688.description_en: Target must answer one single-concept question. Question is asked and answered mentally.

sp-05690.description_en: As Question I, except target must answer 3 questions (a new question can be asked each round).

sp-05692.description_en: Caster receives surface thoughts from target. If the target makes his RR by more than 50 he realizes what is happening. Caster can concentrate on one target each round.

sp-05693.description_en: Caster learns the race, profession, and level of the target.

sp-05694.description_en: Caster knows when anyone within the radius is lying.

sp-05695.description_en: Caster knows if the target is lying.

sp-05697.description_en: As Thoughts, except caster also learns reasoning and thought patterns behind surface thoughts.

sp-05698.description_en: As Truth I, except duration is 3 minutes.

sp-05700.description_en: As Truth I, except duration is 5 minutes.

sp-05701.description_en: As Truth, except range is 10' per level of the caster.

sp-05702.description_en: As in Inner Thoughts, except caster also gets target's conscious memories (at a rate of 1 scene each round).

sp-05707.description_en: As Truth I, except that it can be cast during a Vision Behind spell on the (see the Past Visions spell list). This spell detects lying from anyone speaking in the vision.

sp-05708.description_en: As Mind Scan, except caster can probe target's subconscious memories (i.e., all experiences).

sp-05709.description_en: Caster can remove one thought or memory from the target's mind each round.

sp-05710.description_en: As Truth I with a duration of 1 minute per level or as Truth with a range of 100' per level.

sp-05711.description_en: Gives a general idea of the place of origin of an item.

sp-05712.description_en: Determines if there is a curse is on an item.

sp-05713.description_en: Caster gets a vision up to 1 minute per level into the past (includes sight and sound). Vision must be associated with a place or item touched at the time the spell is cast. Caster is in a trance as long as he concentrates.

sp-05714.description_en: Gives the origin of an item's power.

sp-05715.description_en: This spell gives the caster the ability to scan the past by “feeling the temporal location for significant events.” The caster must cast a Vision Behind spell within one minute after completing this spell.

sp-05716.description_en: Gives a vision of a significant event in an item's past.

sp-05717.description_en: As Vision Behind I, except time limit is 10 minutes per level.

sp-05719.description_en: As Vision Behind I, except time limit is 1 hour per level.

sp-05720.description_en: Gives significant details concerning an item's construction and purpose (not specific powers).

sp-05721.description_en: As Vision Behind I, except time limit is 1 day per level.

sp-05723.description_en: Caster may cast this spell while in a Vision Behind; it saves an image of a person or place that can later be used by another Vision Behind to key in on the saved image in another place or time.

sp-05724.description_en: Gives an analysis of the origin of a curse, the source of its power, and an idea of its effectiveness (i.e., level).

sp-05725.description_en: As Vision Behind I, except time range is 1 year per level.

sp-05730.description_en: If caster has general information concerning an event or place, casting this spell before a Vision Behind will cause the Vision Behind to key in on the event most closely matching the description.

sp-05731.description_en: AsVision Behind I, except time limit is 10 years per level.

sp-05732.description_en: AsVision Behind I, except time limit is 100 years per level.

sp-05733.description_en: AsVision Behind I, except there is no time limit.
